data.name: Gurudwara Smadh Baba Budha Ji
data.address: Village :- Ramdaas, Distt :- Amritsar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI SMADH BABA BUDHA JI SAHIB is situated in the Village Ramdas Distt Amritsar.

During missionary journeys, In Samat 1575 Bikrami 1518 SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI came and sat under a tree of tahli(fig tree), near town ramdas. He met a child there. When GURU SAHIB heard a small child talking on vairag (Separation or detachment) and bibek(prudent) then SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI said that "You are still a kid and you talk like an Wise Man. you are not a kid but an older(Wise Man)". GURU SAHIB blessed him and honor him as wise man. This Tahli Tree is present inside GURUDWARA SAHIB. In 1766, the pyre of Baba Buddha ji was set up by SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI at the place where GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI is parkashit today, according to sikh tradition, ardas was done and Bhai Bhana, younger son of Baba Buddha ji lit the pyre. Near there is a platform called tharha sahib where SHRI GURU HAR GOBIND JI recited kirtan sohila. At the time of death, Baba Buddha ji's age was 125 Years 11 month and 11 days. At the time of cremation ceremony, SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI, bhai bidhi chand, bhai jetha singh and sangat were present there.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Harimandir Sahib
data.address: Gurdwara Shri Harimandir Sahib, Amritsar City, Punjab, India
data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><b>GURUDWARA SHRI HARMANDIR SAHIB</b> is situated in the middle of Amritsar city. It is also known as the Golden Temple or Darbar Sahib (Divine Court). The Golden Temple is a living symbol of the spiritual and historical traditions of the Sikhs. It is a source of inspiration for all Sikhs and their chief place of pilgrimage. The temple with it's glistening gold covered exterior stands in the middle of the tank of nectar. Gurudwara Shri Harmandir Sahib has entrances and doors on all four sides. <b>SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI</b> exclaimed; "My faith is for the people of all castes and all creeds from whichever direction they come and to whichever direction they bow." <b>SHRI GURU AMARDAS SAHIB JI</b> asked <b>SHRI GURU RAMDAS SAHIB JI</b> to build a central place of congregation for the Sikhs. <b>SHRI GURU RAMDAS JI</b> started excavation work in 1577 during his lifetime.  Baba Budha used to monitor the digging work sitting under the Beri situated in the Parikrma. <b>SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV SAHIB JI</b> completed excavation of the Tank known as Amritsar (The Pool of Nectar) in 1588. <strong>SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV SAHIB JI</strong> then started construction of the Temple building himself which was finally completed in 1601. <b>SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV SAHIB JI</b> got the Foundation stone of Gurudwara Shri Harimandir Sahib laid down by Sain Mian Mir a muslim prophet. The first edition of the Holy Book of the Sikh's <b>SHRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI</b> was installed there in 1604 Baba Buddha was appointed the first granthi (caretaker of the book). The last Sikh Guru to live in Amritsar was <b>SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI</b>. The Golden Temple has always been a rallying point for Sikhs throughout it's history. In 1761 the Afghan Ahmed Shah Abdali blew up the Temple and filled in the Sacred Tank with refuse. The great Sikh martyr Baba Deep Singh laid down his life in revenge. The construction of the Golden Temple as it appears today was begun in 1764 when Jassa Singh Ahluwalia laid the foundation stone. Many of the doors, walls and domes were covered with copper sheets overlaid with gold during the reign of Maharaja Ranjit Singh. </p>

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Qilla Mubarak Sahib
data.address: Qilla Mubarak, Bathinda City, Punjab, India
data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><b>GURUDWARA SHRI QILLA MUBARAK SAHIB</b> is situated in the Distt City Bathinda. It is situated inside old Bhathinda Fort, hence the name is Qilla Mubarak Sahib. <b>SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI</b> came to Bathinda via Bhagu. GURU SAHIB met Haaji Ratan, and had discussion with him. GURU SAHIB also set him free from Cycle of Life and Death. When People of Bathinda came to know about GURU SAHIB's visit, They, in large number came for GURU SAHIB's darshan. Further they requested GURU SAHIB to come to Qilla (Fort). Accepting there request GURU SAHIB accompanied them to Qilla. GURU SAHIB came here and asked people that if they have any problem in life. People requested GURU SAHIB that theres a monster ( Deo ) who destroys theres houses and disturbs them. Kindly get them free from from monster.GURU SAHIB called upon monster and asked him that why was he disturbing people. He bowed in front of GURU SAHIB and told that he was hungry from long time. Kindly do some thing for him, he will leave the fort for ever. GURU SAHIB sat for some time and found that there was Bull common of ten villages. People were also disturbed from that Bull. GURU SAHIB send some Singhs to get that Bullock. When Singhs reached village Nat Banger they asked people about that bull. People laughingly told that bull was sitting in water. Bhai Mailagar Singh went to him and asked " Chalo Bhai GURU SAHIB ne Bulayaa hai" Bull came out and Singhs started following him towards Bathinda. Bull reached Fort in front of GURU SAHIB. GURU SAHIB asked Bhai Mailagar Singh to cut Bull's head in one attempt of sword. Bhai Sahib did the same way. And it was offered to monster and his hunger was fullfilled. GURU SAHIB sent monster to sirhind and told him that his services will be needed there. Then people requested GURU SAHIB that this area is drought and theres scarcity of water. GURU SAHIB told them that he will take drough with him towards south.</p>

GURU SAHIB stayed here for 9 days. Along with GURU SAHIB was Mata Sunder Kaur Ji and Mata Sahib Kaur Ji. There are many Belongings of GURU SAHIB, Mata Sahib Kaur Ji, and Mai Desan Ji preserved here.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Damdama Sahib
data.address: Sabo Ki Talwandi, Distt :- Bathinda, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI DAMDAMA SAHIB is situated in the Talwandi Sabo In Bathinda Distt.

This Holy Takht is 4th Takht of Khalsa Panth. In the year 1705 A.D. SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI while fighting against the cruel rulers, after leaving Shri Anandpur Sahib, Chamkaur Sahib, Deena Kaangar, Muktsar Sahib, Lakhi Jungle, Pakka Pathrala and touching various places with his holy presence, reached here in the year 1705 A.D. It was here that GURU SAHIB took rest by untying his waist band on a raised platform surrounded by Kareer trees. This place became famous as Damdama Sahib. GURU SAHIB stayed at this place for around 1 1/4 year. It was here that GURU SAHIB tested the Singhs for their faith in Sikhism with gun's target. GURU SAHIB also baptised the chaudhary of this area named Baba Dall & gave him the name of Dall Singh. This was the place where Guru Ji also got the holy Beed of Aad Guru Granth Sahib Ji written by Martyr Bhai Mani Singh Ji. This place in remembrance is named as Gurudwara Damdama Sahib. Martyr BABA DEEP SINGH JI got the copies done of the Beed (GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI) & sent it to the 4 Takhts. On Vaisakhi, the Khalsa Foundation Day, it was second time that 1.25 Lakh Singhs were baptised due to which every year on the occasion of Vaisakhi, Sikh followers celebrate it with belief & enthusiasm.

data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><b>GURUDWARA SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI SAHIB</b> is situated in the village Chak Fateh Singh Wala, Distt Bathinda. After the battle of Mukatsar Sahib <b>SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI</b> was staying at Talwandi Sabo (Gurudwara Shri Damdama Sahib). Mai Deesan Ji was great Disciple of GURU SAHIB. She always wanted to Have GURU SAHIB's darshan and also to serve him. Just to fulfill her desire GURU SAHIB came here. This place was open area in those times. GURU SAHIB got his tent pitched at this place near village pond (Chapar). Which is now converted into Sarovar. From Here Mai Deesan Ji took GURU SAHIB to her home and served him with great devotion. GURU SAHIB stayed there for many days. GURU SAHIB's many belongings are still preserved there at their home Gurudwara Shri Burj Sahib.</p>

data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI GURUSAR SAHIB is situated in the village Bhundar, Distt Bathinda.

When BHAI BIDHI CHAND JI brought second horse from lahore fort SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI was at village Kangar with Rai Jodh. At the time of leaving Lahore fort Bhai Bidhi Chand had informed mughal authorities that this horse belonged to SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI and his name is Bidhi Chand. Earlier also he had taken horse to GURU SAHIB and is taking this horse to GURU SAHIB. When Bhai Bidhi chand ji reached GURU SAHIB, he explained the whole story. So it was sure that mughal army will be following and there will big battle. In search of right place for battle GURU SAHIB reached here and met Baba Peer. GURU SAHIB discussed situation with him. Baba Peer suggested the place near Village Nathana. As it was having water reservoir near it and a dense forest also. GURU SAHIB stayed here for a night. Next morning GURU SAHIB had bath in the dhab (Pond) and recited "Satnam Waheguru" and left for further journey.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Jand Sahib

data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><b>GURUDWARA SHRI JAND SAHIB</b> is situated near Village Kotha Guru, Distt Bathinda. Bhai Rupa and Sadhu Ji went to fields to harvest some crops. They took goat Skin water container. It was hanged on branch of tree. It was quite a hot day. After working for some time when they felt thirsty, they came to drink water and felt that water too cold. Moved with devotion, they offered the water to <b>SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI</b> in their thoughts. That first GURU SAHIB should drink then only they will drink it. And again they started working, time passed and they fell unconsciously. GURU SAHIB was at Bhai Ki Daroli. When GURU SAHIB came to know about his sikhs. He started from there riding his horse reached here covering the distance of 30 miles. When GURU SAHIB reached there he called them if some one could water he (GURU SAHIB) was feeling thirsty. When Bhai Rup chand ji saw above GURU SAHIB standing in from of them. He called his father and both of them fell on the feet of GURU SAHIB. GURU SAHIB himself drank water and also offered them water and told them leave this job. You need to meditate now. GURU SAHIB gave them sword and told them to spread the message of Sikhism. Bhai Sadhu Ji told that people of there village feel jealous of them. GURU SAHIB told them leave that place and suggested them a new place. Start your own Village. People will follow you. Name it as Bhai Rupe Ka. GURU SAHIB stayed there for a night.</p>

data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI PATSHAHI CHEVIN SAHIB is situated in village Kangar Distt. Bathinda.

This village is adjoining to the village Dina, Distt Moga, (GURUDWARA SHRI LOHGARH SAHIB) This place was fort of Rai Jodh grandsaon of Baba Mithasar. When SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI came to Bhai Rupa (Distt Bhathinda) Rai Jodh ji requested GURU SAHIB to visit his home. Bhai Bidhi Chand ji brought second Horse from Lahore to this place. Under guidance of GURU SAHIB Rai Jodh ji fought the battle of Mehraj and with Lala Beg and Kamar Beg. Rai Jodh ji killed Kamar Beg and GURU SAHIB killed Lala Beg. GURU SAHIB gave Rai Jodh ji a Katar (a sort of Dager), Which is still preserved with Rai Jodh Ji's family. Rai Jodh ji's family house where Katar is preserved is situated on the back side of GURUDWARA SAHIB.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Patshahi Chevin Sahib
data.address: Village :- Bhai Rupa, Distt :- Bathinda, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA BHAI RUP CHAND JI SAHIB is situated in Village Bhai Rupa Distt Bathinda.

Bhai Sadhu ji and his son Bhai Rup Chand ji were great disciple of SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI. Bhai Rupa and Sadhu Ji went to fields to harvest some crops. They took goat Skin water container. It was hanged on branch of tree. It was quite a hot day. After working for some time when they felt thirsty, they came to drink water and felt that water too cold. Moved with devotion, they offered the water to SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI in their thoughts. That first GURU SAHIB should drink then only they will drink it. And again they started working, time passed and they fell unconsciously. GURU SAHIB was at Bhai Ki Daroli. When GURU SAHIB came to know about his sikhs. He started from there riding his horse reached here covering the distance of 30 miles. When GURU SAHIB reached there he called them if some one could water he (GURU SAHIB) was feeling thirsty. When Bhai Rup chand ji saw above GURU SAHIB standing in fron of them. He called his father and both of them fell on the feets of GURU SAHIB. GURU SAHIB himself drank water and also offred them water and told them leave this job. You need to meditate now. GURU SAHIB gave them sword and told them to spread the message of Sikhism. Bhai Sadhu Ji told that people of there village feel jealous of them. GURU SAHIB told them leave that place and suggested them a new place. Start your own Village. People will follow you. Name it as Bhai Rupe Ka. GURU SAHIB stayed there for a night. GURU SAHIB laid foundation of this village by installing wooden pillar.(Which still exist here.) GURU SAHIB himself stayed for 6 months and 9 Days at this place and help people settle here. Later GURU SAHIB came here along with army. Bhai Rup Chand ji keep spreading message of gurbani. His two sons Bhai Dharam ji and Bhai Param ji also became SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI devotees. They stayed with SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI till hazoor sahib. Bhai Dharam Singh gave news of GURU SAHIB's Jyoti Jot. When Bhai Rup Chand ji came to know about this he also left for heavenly abode. The place where Bhai Rup Chand Ji left his body is Bhai Ki Samadh.

Rath Sahib(a Chariot) preserved here was offered by Sangat of Kashmir to SHRI GURU RAM DAS JI. later SHRI GURU RAM DAS SAHIB JI, SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV SAHIB JI, Mata Ganga Ji, SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI, AND SHRI GURU HARRAI SAHIB JI used this Rath Sahib. Mata Ji went to seek blessings of a son from Baba Buddha Ji on this rath sahib.

Bhai Ram Rai Ji on directions of SHRI GURU HARRAI SAHIB JI went to delhi to meet Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb on this Rath Sahib. But he disobeyed GURU SAHIB's order and distorted Gurbani. When GURU SAHIB came to know this, He sent message to Ram Rai Ji and asked him not to show his face in life. Bhai Ram Rai Ji went to Dehradun and stayed there for his rest of life. This rath remained with him till end of life. Later his Wife Mata Punjab Kaur Ji spread news that whoso ever can take this Rath sahib without Horse or Ox can take this Rath. Bhai Dharam Singh Ji brought this rath from Dehradun by himself pulling it.

Bhai Dyal Das had denied to Baptise from Rangrete Singhs. When he came to know about GURU SAHIB's visit in village Chak, he prepared karah prasad and sent to GURU SAHIB. But GURU SAHIB refused to accept it. He again loaded that prasad in bullock cart and came here following GURU SAHIB. He asked GURU SAHIB to forgive him for his mistake. GURU SAHIB got that karah prasad distributed in Sangat and Baptised him. He became Dyal Singh from Dyal Das. Second Day GURU SAHIB and sangat had bath in sarovar and had Nitnem Paath and left for Qilla Mubarak Sahib, Bathinda. Second time GURU SAHIB came here while coming back from Lakhi jungel. GURU SAHIB stayed here for some time and had rest. And later left for Talwandi Sabo Sahib.

data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI RAMSAR SAHIB is situated in village Mehraj Distt Bathinda.

SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI came to this area, stopped here. In those times this area belonged to Bhullar Jats. Resident of this village a Sidhu Jat was staying in near by area. He met GURU SAHIB and explained his problem. He told GURU SAHIB these Bhullars are not allowing him to stay int his village and neither they accept their daughters for marriage. And also when ever ladies from their household goes to fetch water from well, Bhullars tease them. GURU SAHIB called BHullars and asked them to give land to Sidhu Jats and also accept there relations, but they refused. GURU SAHIB asked Mohan Ji (a sidhu jat) to When sun sets you people can sit anywhere and start it as your own village. Bhai Mohan Ji started and from some distance from here started covering there own area. And also during the night they raised fencing around it. In the morning when Bhullars came to know about this they tried to fight. But GURU SAHIB himself came to help Sidhu Jats along with his force. With Blessing of GURU SAHIB they won and after that this village belongs to Sidhu Jats.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Taruana Sahib
data.address: Village :- Maluka, Teh :- Rampura Phull, Distt :- Bathinda, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI TARUANA SAHIB is situated in Village Maluka, Distt Bathinda.

SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI stopped here while coming from Lambhwali after spending the afternoon. GURU SAHIB stayed here at "Maluke Da tobha". Tents were pitched and they stayed for night. In the morning Local sardar Maluka came here for GURU SAHIB's darshan. Singhs stopped him and didnt allowed to have GURU SAHIB's darshan. But Still he tried to enter the tent forcibly. Bhai Bhagu Singh attacked him with sword. That person fell unconscious. After few hours when he was awake, He asked Singh "Bhai Sahib i have very less breathes left, Please let me have GURU SAHIB's darshan." Listening this GURU SAHIB came outside the tent. He bowed in front of GURU SAHIB and kissed GURU SAHIB's feet. GURU SAHIB asked if you want to live should i make you fit and fine again. He said GURU SAHIB please allow him to leave for Sachkhand Sahib. I am blessed that in my end time i have your glimpse. GURU SAHIB put his hand on malukas head and he left for heavenly abode. GURU SAHIB set him free from cycle of life and death and gave him name of Taran taaran. and after that this place was known as Gurudwara Shri Taruana Sahib.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Manji Sahib
data.address: Village :- Alamgir, Distt :- Ludhiana, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI MANJI SAHIB (ALAMGIR SAHIB) is situated in the Village Alamgir In Distt Ludhiana.

SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI, after his four sons & mother were martyred by the Mughals, was going from Machhiwara on a bed as " Uchh Da Pir " & reached here on 14 Poh 1761 Bikrami (1704 A.D.). On reaching here , one of the horse traders of the village named Bhai Nigahia Singh, gifted a horse to GURU SAHIB. Nabi Khan & Gani Khan were sent back with the bed. GURU SAHIB asked an old lady who was picking cow dung whether he could get some water from somewhere to take bath to which the old lady replied that " Pir Ji this is a place of ruins, there is no water here. There is a well far away but there is a big python that lives there, no one goes there. GURU SAHIB Ji hit the python with an arrow & gave it " Mukti " ( exemption from further transmigration ) & the python fell into the well. When the Sikhs went to fetch water, the water had gone bad so close to where GURU SAHIB was sitting, GURU SAHIB hit one more arrow & there was a water spring that came out & all the sikhs had a bath. On seeing this miracle, the old lady fell into GURU SAHIB's feet & said " Peer Ji you are a wonderful Peer, I have a request. I have leprosy & i have gone to various places to get the treatment done but it has not been cured, kindly cure my disease & help me to get rid of this disease. GURU SAHIB said that whoever takes a bath under this water spring with belief, GOD will cure all his sadness. Then GURU JI sat on the horse given by Bhai Nigahia Singh & went towards Raikot. The old lady had a bath in that water spring & was cured. She went back to the village & told about the whole story. The place where Bhai Nabi Khan & Bhai Gani Khan kept GURU SAHIB\"s bed, today at that place exists a beautiful Gurudwara known as Manji Sahib.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Charan Kanwal Sahib
data.address: Village :- Machiwara, Distt :- Ludhiana, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI CHARAN KANWAL SAHIB is situated in the Machiwara town of Ludhiana Distt.

After Martyrdom of his two Sahibjadas and many sikhs SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI left the fort of SHRI CHAMKAUR SAHIB and reached village CHUHARPUR and sat to relax under tree, Where GURUDWARA SHRI JHAR SAHIB is situated. From there he came to the jungles of MACHIWARA SAHIB. GURU SAHIB reached near well. he drank water from that well then took tind (a Pot which draws water from well) and used it as pillow under JAND tree to spend his night. That old jand tree is still present. Here while remembering God GURU SAHIB Recited the Shabad

"Mitar Payare nu Haal Murida Da Kehna
Tud Bin Rog, Rajaina da Odan Naga Niwaasan De Rehna Shul Surahi,
Khanjar Pyale Bing Kasaian de Rehna Mitar Payare nu Haal Murida Da Kehna"

Here two out of Punj Piyaraas Bhai Dharam Singh Ji and Bhai Daya Singh Ji and one another sikh Bhai Man Singh ji met GURU SAHIB. In the morning care taker of this baag came and saw GURU SAHIB. He informed owners Bhai Gulaba Ji and Bhai Punjaba Ji. Who later came and requested GURU SAHIB to come to their house. Accepting the request GURU SAHIB went along with them at place where GURDWARA SRI CHAUBARA SAHIB is situated..

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Chaubara Sahib
data.address: Village :- Machiwara, Distt :- Ludhiana, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURDWARA SRI CHAUBARA SAHIB is situated in the Machiwara Sahib town in Ludhiana Distt.

The SRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came to this place from GURDWARA SRI CHARAN KANWAL SAHIB. This place belonged to Gulaba & Punjaba who used to supply ration to GURU SAHIB at ANANDPUR SAHIB. On request of these brothers, GURU SAHIB came to there house. MATA HERDEYI, who used to offer a hand made clothing every year to GURU SAHIB at ANANDPUR SAHIB, Now she was not able to offer at SHRI ANADPUR SAHIB the clothing from quite sometime due to her old age. MATA JI offered the clothing and GURU SAHIB blessed MATA JI happy by accepting her offerings. Pathan Gani Khan Nabi Khan also lived in the same city, who used to offer horse to GURU SAHIB at ANANDPUR SAHIB. When they came to know that GURU SAHIB had come to their village, Gani Khan Nabi Khan went and requested SATGURU JI to come to their house and bless them. While following GURU SAHIB, mughal army, also reached Machhiwara. so they requested that if GURU SAHIB can come in a blue dress, then it would be easy for them to serve. A dyer was called upon and GURU SAHIB ordered him to color His clothes. The dyer told GURU SAHIB the clothes are dyed when the matti (A large earthen pot) is fully prepared and it takes 3 days time to get that prepared after putting color in it. GURU SAHIB told that the matti is already prepared, and he was amazed to see the matti was boiling. The dyer got sure that He is a Hermit of GOD & he should ask for something for himself. After coloring the clothes, he presented it in GURU SAHIB's feet, the dyer stood with folded hands in front of GURU SAHIB. GURU SAHIB wanted to pay something in return for coloring the clothes but the dyer refused to take it. GURU SAHIB asked him that what does he want ? The dyer requested that GURU SAHIB i donot have any child, kindly bless me. The second request is that i am unable to earn enough for a living, not able to pay off the debt from money earned by color, Kindly bless me. GURU SAHIB replied that the matti in which you have colored my clothes, you need not add any color into it from now onward think of any color in your heart and dip the clothes, the clothes will be colored with that color. Keep the matti covered and donot tell this secret to anyone. GURUDWARA SRI CHAUBARA SAHIB exists on that place which is around 500 yards from this place. Gani Khan Nabi Khan requested that even they donot have any child, to which GURU SAHIB said that your service has already been accepted & whatever blessings were given are listed in the HUKAMNAMA. That matt (A large earthen pot) still exists at GURDWARA SAHIB for the followers to see.

GURUDWARA SHRI CHOLA SAHIB is situated in the village Ghudaani Kalan, Distt Ludhiana. GURU SAHIB stayed here in this village for 45 days. Happy from sewa of the Bhai Surtya ji and villagers GURU SAHIB blessed villagers with following these

  • CHOLA SAHIB with 52 KALIAN (CHOLA SAHIB USED BY GURU SAHIB WHILE COMING OUT OF GWALIOR FORT TO SET 52 RAJPUT RULLERS FREE)

  • JORA SAHIB

The dyer requested that GURU SAHIB i don't have any child, kindly bless me. DASHMESH PITA stayed at this place for 2 days and 2 nights. From this place, GURU SAHIB along with Gani Khan, Nabi Khan, Bhai Daya Singh Ji, Bhai Dharam Singh Ji, Bhai Maan Singh Ji went to GURUDWARA SRI KIRPAN BHET SAHIB in a Palang (Bed), which is about 2 kms away from this place, going through GURUDWARA SRI KATANA SAHIB via village Rampura Kanech went towards Alamgir.

Note: SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI, while accepting the service of Gani Khan Nabi Khan, gave this HUKAMNAMA to him at GURUDWARA SHRI ALAMGIR SAHIB. The photocopy of the same has been kept at GURUDWARA SHRI GANI KHAN NABI KHAN.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Gaughat Sahib
data.address: Gaushala Road, Old Ludhiana City, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI GAU GHAT SAHIB is situated in Ludhiana City. It is situated on Gaushala Road Old Ludhiana.

SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI came here in 1515, and rested here on the Bank of river Satluj. GURU SAHIB Recited their divine baani, in praise of God. The Nawab of Lodhi(Ludhiana) Jalal-udd-din came to GURU SAHIB with his Counties. He offered his services to GURU SAHIB and also requested GURU SAHIB to save the town from erosion by the Satluj River. GURU SAHIB replied to him, that he should serve his people by doing justice. Satluj river will move miles away from this City and this place will be fully Prosperous and people will live happily. As here nearby is situated Gau Shala hence the name of GURUDWARA SAHIB was named as Shri Gau Ghat Sahib.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Guru Gobind Singh Ji

GURUDWARA SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI is situated in Village Kamalpura Distt Ludhiana.

SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came here from Machiwara-Ghulal-Hayer. at this place was crossings. One way was going towards Raikot-Jagran, One to Hayer, One to Lame Jattpura, GURU SAHIB liked this place and rested here near a pond. Here only GURU SAHIB blessed Mai Bhatti that her sone will have three marriages. Daughter of Rai Kall of raikot was married to to Alam Khan of Kotla Nihang Khan (Gurudwara Shri Bhatta Sahib, Ropar) These both families were followers of GURU SAHIB. Alam khan sent the news to Rai Kalla of GURU SAHIB\"s arrival in this area. Rai Kalla came here with amy of 300 Horse riders. When he sa GURU SAHIB sitting on bed. He took of the horse and came bare footed. He bowed his head in front of GURU SAHIB. After resting for some time here, Rai Kall requested GURU SAHIB to come along with him to nearby place of Village Lameh Jattpura. After reaching Lameh Jattpura GURU SAHIB asked Rai Kall to send some body to fetch the news of Mata Gujari Ji and Chotte Sahibzade Ji.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Gurusar Sahib
data.address: Village :- Sudhar, Distt :- Ludhiana, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURDWARA SRI GURUSAR SAHIB is situated in village Sudhar Distt Ludhiana.

SRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI came here from Daroli Bhai Ki Via Madoke, Lopo and Sidhva. GURU SAHIB stopped here near Dhab (Water Reservoir). News of GURU SAHIB's arrival was spread in whole village. People started coming to have glimpse of GURU SAHIB. Bhai Javanda who was also known as Bhai Prema Ji along with Village Sangat came for GURU SAHIB's darshan. There used to be Kirtan and religious discussion in day time and games competition in the evening. Once GURU SAHIB left for hunting Bhai Prema ji started walking along with GURU SAHIB holding Rein of GURU SAHIB's Horse. Bhai Prema ji walking barefoot kept the horse walking on plain route and he himself walked on grass and thorns. While walking for some time his foot got injured and there was lot of blood. GURU SAHIB gave him his shoes to wear But Bhai Sahib instead of putting it on placed it reverentially on his head. And with this Bhai Prema Ji started walking again. When GURU SAHIB saw this, he asked Bhai Sahib that he had given him sleepers to wear. The Bhai Prema Ji replied, On which feet whole world bows there head, Shoes worn by those feet are worth worship. GURU SAHIB blessed Bhai Sahib with love. That jora Sahib is still preserved here for Sangat in Bhai Prema's House in Village Sudhar.

Bhai Bhakhat Mal, Bhai Tara Chand Ji and Bhai Dyal Chand Ji from Kabul along with Sangat reached here to pay visit to GURU SAHIB. Karori Mal trader had brought two Horses of superior breed as offering for GURU SAHIB. On their way, at Lahore these horses were snatched away by the Mughal forces and handed over to the Nawaab of Lahore and these were kept in a stable in the fort of Lahore. Bhai Karori mal was forced to sign the recievings for Cheque (hundi) of Rs two Lakh and Rs five thousand cash. Bhai Karori Mal ji placed Hundis in front of GURU SAHIB and told the whole story behind this. GURU SAHIB consoled them and said your offerings are accepted. Now he himself will get his offerings back from Mughals. Local people served the Sangat from Kabul with great devotion.

Few days later, When Diwan was going on GURU SAHIB asked Sangat, If someone can bring back the Horses from Lahore. Bhai Raja Partap ji said that only Bhai Bidhi Chand ji can do this. And Bhai Bidhi Chand Ji was assigned this Task. After taking blessings from GURU SAHIB Bhai Bidhi Chand ji started his journey to lahore.

When he came to know that GURU SAHIB, he requested GURU SAHIB to cure him. GURU SAHIB asked him to put foam from horse mouth on his body and take bath in the pond near by. When that person did these things he was cured. Even now people having skin disease take bath here. Here is also a Bohar Tree. GURU SAHIB told Sangat that its Amb Tree. Sangat said no GURU SAHIB its Bohar Tree. GURU SAHIB said again that its Amb Tree. Second time again Sangat said that no its Bohar Tree. Now the leaves of this Tree are just like that of Amb Tree.

data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI HAVELI SAHIB is situated in the village Ghudaani Kalan, Distt Ludhiana.

When SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI came to Village Ghudaani Kalan, He first stoped at a place where GURUDWARA SHRI DAMDAMA SAHIB is situated. At that time a Sadhu was living there. He served GURU SAHIB with water. He had discussions with GURU SAHIB. GURU SAHIB also set him free from the cycle of life and death. GURU SAHIB also blessed him that his Singhs will first pay homage at your smadh situated inside the Gurudwara Premises and then will come to Gurudwara Sahib. GURU SAHIB stayed at Baba Sutya Ji's house for 45 days. GURU SAHIB got pleased from his services and while going from here GURU SAHIB gave Bhai Surtya Ji a Chola Sahib (52 Kalian Wala) Pothi Sahib, I Jora Sahib, Ban. GURU SAHIB also gave him a Bharola Sahib. GURU SAHIB himself put some wheat Grains in it and blessed that there will be no shortage of food in their house. And Langar should go on. But also stopped them not to see inside the Bharola Sahib. Five generations of Bhai Surtya Ji followed GURU SAHIB's order for almost 180 years. But daughter in law from fifth generation unknowingly took off the Bharola Sahibs cover. And after that there were no wheat grains in it.

GURU SAHIB rested here for some time and went for further Journey. A Local farmer Fatta came to GURU SAHIB and offered for any service GURU SAHIB would like to get done. GURU SAHIB asked him to lend his horse(GURU SAHIB knew about his horse as he used to visit GURU SAHIB at Anadpur Sahib riding that Horse). Fatta went home and brought a little mare (female horse). When fatta reached home he found that his horse died of snake bite.

After evacuating Shri Anandpur Sahib, SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came here from Machiwara via Ghulal, lall Kalan, Katana, Rampur. GURU SAHIB stopped here to take rest. Mata Bhatti of this Village received GURU SAHIB with great devotion and served GURU SAHIB with Langar. After taking rest for Some time GURU SAHIB asked for some convenience to leave further. Mata's three son took Manji on there shoulder and carried GURU SAHIB to Village Kamalpura. Happy with their service GURU SAHIB blessed Mata and asked for her wish. When GURU SAHIB asked third time for her wish, She told that his son's are not getting married and She was worried for this. GURU SAHIB said smilingly that your son will get married for Seven times. Later his son got married for Seven times and three Villages were formed after them. Rajoana Kalan, Rajoana Khurd and Village Tughal.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Patshahi Chevin Sahib
data.address: Village :- Gujjranwala, Distt :- Ludhiana, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI PATSHAHI CHEVIN SAHIB is situated in Village Gujjarwala Distt ludhiana.

SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI stayed for some time while coming back from Battle of Mehraj along with 2200 Horse riders army. When GURU SAHIB came here, people of nearby area came to know about GURU SAHIB. When Village Chaudhary Fatuhi came to know about GURU SAHIB's arrival, he along with his sewadars came in service of GURU SAHIB. He offered GURU SAHIB his services. But GURU SAHIB declined. When he made many request to give him any service, GURU SAHIB asked him to give his Hawk, But on the name of hawk he he got confused and denied to give. When Chaudhary came back to his Qila, Hawk swallowed his thong and was acutely sick. Chaudhary tried his best to cure him, Finally he brought hawk in darbar of GURU SAHIB. And he requested GURU SAHIB to save his life. The moment GURU SAHIB patted the hawk, he vomited and was fit and fine. Chaudhary understood his mistake and offered Hawk to GURU SAHIB. But GURU SAHIB denied to accept.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Patshahi Chevin Sahib
data.address: Village :- Heran, Teh :- Sudhar, Distt :- Ludhiana, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI PATSHAHI CHEVIN SAHIB is situated in Village Heran Teh Raikot Distt ludhiana.

This Sacred Place has been visited By SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB and SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI. SHRI GURU AMARDAS JI sent Bhai Hameera Ji to spread the message of Sikhism in this area. SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI came at Village Sudhar from Bhai Ki Daroli via Madoke, Lopo, Sidhwaan etc. GURU SAHIB stayed at Sudhar for Six months. GURU SAHIB sent his sikhs to find out Bhai Hameera Ji. When Sewaks asked about Bhai Hameera Ji and told them that GURU SAHIB had asked to bring milk from Bhai Sahib, People laughed and said Bhai Hameera has only Ausar Jhoti. When Sewaks reached Bhai Hameera and asked him for milk he pointed towards ausar jhoti. And that Jhoti gave bucket full of milk. And during that stay he came to Heran Also. Bhai Hameera Ji's wife expected for a Son. With GURU SAHIB's blessing they got Mahant Kirpal Das Ji as there Son. Mahant Kirpal Das ji further supported SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI in battle of Bhangani. He crushed General Hayat Khan in the battle. SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI gave Mahant Kirpal Das Ji his half turban. After Battle Mahant ji came back to Village Heran. Bhai Gani Khan and Nabi Khan carried SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI as uch da peer on Bed. GURU SAHIB reached here via Katana Almgir mohie etc. From here GURU SAHIB sent Bhai Gani Khan and Nabi Khan back and gifted them Gold Kangan and Hukamnama.

Riding the horse from Alamgir GURU SAHIB stopped at Duley and then reached here in morning. Suddenly Horse got obstacle here and stopped. He didnt asked any thing for himself but asked for bless this place and village Dulon Kalan. GURU SAHIB also blessed sant Ji to be amar. From here onwards GURU SAHIB left for further journey to Village Rattan.

data.description:
<p style="text-align: justify;"><b>GURUDWARA SHRI TAHLIANA SAHIB </b>is situated in the Raikot city of Distt Ludhiana. GURU SAHIB came here all the from MACHIWARA SAHIB via Alamgeer Sahib. When <b>SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI</b> came to this place at that time, Paali Noora Maahi of Rai Kalle used to graze cattle. GURU SAHIB asked him to provide milk to which Noora requested that he had just milked the buffaloes. Then GURU SAHIB pointed towards one of the buffaloes and asked him to milk that buffalo to which Noora replied that he doesn't have a utensil. GURU SAHIB gave him Ganga Sagar, around which there were 288 holes. Noora tied the buffalo to one Karaunda shrub and was astonished to see that when the buffalo gave milk, in spite of the 288 holes in the Ganga Sagar, the milk did not come out. On seeing this miracle, Noora was very happy and told the whole story to Rai Kalle. Rai Kalla and other people came to have glimpse of GURU SAHIB.</p>


<p style="text-align: justify;">Sitting at this place GURU SAHIB asked Rai Kalle to provide some horse riders, so that he could send them to Sirhind to get news about Mata Gujari Ji and younger Sahibjada's. Rai Kalle accepted the service at once sent Noora to Sirhind to get news about Mata Gujari younger Sahibzaada's as Noora's sister Nooran was married at Sirhind. Accepting the order he went to his sister in Sirhind. On hearing about Mata Gujari ji and Sahibzaada's, he came back to Raikot told the whole story to GURU SAHIB that younger Sahibzaada's had been martyred by bricking them alive as the Sahibzaada's didn't accept Islam. On hearing the news, GURU SAHIB dug out the root of Kaahi's plant with the help of his arrow declared that Mughal rule roots have been dug. At that time, Rai Kalle requested that he is also a Turkish. GURU SAHIB was very pleased with Rai Kalle's service so GURU SAHIB presented him a Sword (Khanda), Ganga Sagar (with 288 holes) a Rehal said that till the time you keep good care of these things, nothing would happen to your rule</p>

On 7 Poh Samat 1761, He reached at this place. GURU SAHIB send his 5 singhs to Rai Jagat singh, who was the owner of the garhi, to ask him for shelter for some time. Singhs went to Jagat singh and conveyed the message of GURU SAHIB and also said that GURU SAHIB is in the orchid which is situated outside the town.</p>

<p style="text-align: justify;">On listening this Rai Jagat got scared from the Muslim troops, He just ignored them and said that he is unable to give his offerings and is not worth to take care of GURU SAHIB. After listening to Jagat singh's answer Sikhs returned to GURU SAHIB and told whole conversation. Then GURU SAHIB sent one sikh with 50 coins again to that place. Singhs requested Jagat Singh's younger brother Roop chand to give his place. Roop chand took 50 coins and gave his half share in that Garhi. GURU SAHIB with his 2 sons and 40 singhs moved to that Garhi. on this Rai Jagat informed the mughal troops in Roop Nagar which were searching for GURU SAHIB. The troops reached the ghari and surrounded the area. By seeing this GURU SAHIB prepared his singhs for the war which is Called The Battle of Chamkaur. </p>

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Garhi Sahib
data.address: Chamkaur Sahib, Distt :- Ropar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI GARHI SAHIB is situated at Chamkaur Sahib in Distt Ropar.

SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI and the 40 sikhs took shelter in a house after evacuating SHRI ANANDPUR SAHIB. They were attacked by the enemy on December 22, 1705. GURUDWARA SHRI GARHI SAHIB marks the site of the fortress like double story house, with a high compound wall around it and only one entrance from the north, which was used by SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI as a temporary citadel in the unequal battle of Chamkaur on 7th December, 1705. While occupying the house during the night of 6-7 December, GURU JI ordered 8 sikhs each to guard four sides. While another two, Maan Singh and Kotha Singh was posted at the entrance. SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI, with his sons Sahibzaada Ajit Singh and Sahibzaada Jujhar Singh took position on the first floor of the house in the center. Mughal now surrounded the `Garhi". The battle raged throughout the day. Sikhs started coming out in small batches to engage the enemy the hand to hand fight. Two such successive sallies were led by the Sahibzada Ajit Singh and Sahibzaada Jujhar Singh, 18 and 14 years old respectively, who like the other sikhs fell fighting heroically. By nightfall SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI was left with only five sikhs in the fortress. These five sikhs urged him to escape so that he could rally his supporters again and continue the struggle against oppression. GURU SAHIB agreed, he gave his own attire to Sangat Singh who resembled him in features and physical stature. Under the cover of darkness GURU JI made good his way through the encircling host slackened by the fatigue of the day's battle. Daya Singh, Dharam Singh and Man Singh also escaped leaving behind only two sikhs, Sangat Singh and Sant Singh. Next day when, imperial trops entered the garhi, they were surprised to find only two occupants, who died rather than giving in. SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI obeyed the five sikh here and gave his dress to Bhai Jeevan Singh( Bhai Jaita JI). Salana Jor Mela and Dusehra are celebrated here.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Katalgarh Sahib
data.address: Chamkaur Sahib, Distt :-Ropar, Punjab, India
data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><b>GURUDWARA SHRI KATALGARH SAHIB JI</b> is situated at Chamkaur Sahib in Distt Ropar. The ground around Gurudwara Katal Garh Sahib was the area of battle. It is about 100 yards from the site of GURUDWARA SHRI KACHI GARHI. It saw the bloodiest and unique battle of history. Sahibzada, Ajit Singh, Sahibzada Jujhar Singh showed their exemplary valour and had fatal encounters with the enemy. Along with two Sahibzadas, Three out of Panj Piaras, Bhai Himat Singh, Bhai Mohkam Singh, Bhai Sahib Singh and other Sikhs tasted martyrdom at this site.As per Gurmata of 5 Sikhs stayed in the Kachi Garhi, <b>SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI</b> had to leave the fortress on the night of 22-23 December,1704. While going outside Chamkaur, GURU SAHIB passed through a nearby village called Raipur. Here, GURU SAHIB met a devout Bibi Sharan Kaur. GURU SAHIB detailed her about the situation in Chamkaur and entrusted her the duty of cremation of Sahibzadas and other Sikhs. After blessing her, GURU SAHIB moved towards Jand Jungle.Muslim poet Allahayar Khan Jogi has written, about this place:-</p>“ <b>Bas ek Hind mein tirth hai yatra ke liyae, Katai Bap ne betey jahan khuda ke liyae.</b>

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Manji Sahib
data.address: Anandpur Sahib, Distt :- Ropar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI DUMALGARH SAHIB(MANJI SAHIB) is situated in the City of Anandpur Sahib in Ropar Distt.

This GURUDWARA SAHIB is on the northern side of GURUDWARA SHRI KESGARH SAHIB. Here, SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI used to train his sons and also used as a playing ground. Wrestling matches and other competitions were also held here. GURU SAHIB was sitting here under a bunyan tree when Ajmer Chand, the ruler of Bilaspur attacked Anandpur Sahib. In the battle field, the Sikhs, under the command of Bhai Maan Singh Nishanchi (standard bearer), gave a befitting fight to the hill army. During the battle Bhai Maan Singh was wounded and the Khalsa flag was broken. A Sikh soldier reported the incident to GURU SAHIB. At this GURU SAHIB tore a farra (small piece of cloth) from his Keski (under-turban) and set it in his turban in the from of a hanging flag. GURU SAHIB declared that in future Khalsa flag shall never fall or get lowered. It will be a part of the turban of every Sikh leader. SAHIBZADA FATEH SINGH JI, who was just five years old at that time, also hung a farra in his turban. Since this incident the tradition of farra became a part of the turban of every Sikh leaders. Now, this tradition is no more in practice except with the Nihangs who observe it with religious fervor. This GURUDWARA SAHIB is known as Dumalgarh also as it owes its name to Dumala (farra) incident.

Some relics belonging to her are preserved here. An embroidered handkerchief, a hand fan, a volume of hymns and a Seli-topi(a sort of cap). Seli-topi belonged to SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI, Baba Shri Chand ji Son of SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI, had gifted the same to Baba Gurditta Ji(grandfather of Bibi Rup Kaur ji) and Bibi Rup Kaur Ji had received as gift from her grandmother.

GURDWARA SRI PATAL PURI SAHIB is situated in the Kiratpur City Of Ropar Distt.

SRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI and SRI GURU HAR RAI SAHIB JI were cremated at this place. Ashes of SRI GURU HARKRISHAN SAHIB JI from delhi and Baba Ram Rai Ji's ashes from dehradun were brought here and flowed into river. Baba Ani Ray Ji, son of SRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI also left his body at this place and his last rites were performed at this place. At first there were separate places for SRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI SRI GURU HAR RAI SAHIB JI and SRI GURU HARKRISHAN SAHIB JI Ji but later a one single big GURUDWARA SAHIB hall was constructed.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Patshahi Dasvin Sahib
data.address: Village :- Khera Kalmot, Teh :- Nangal, Distt :- Ropar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI PATSHAHI DASVIN SAHIB is situated in the Village Kalmot, Teh Nangal Distt Ropar.

GURUDWARA SAHIB is situated on the hill top in village Kamlot. SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI was staying in Bibhour. People from everywhere started coming to Bibhour place to see their almighty when they came to know about the presence of SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI. People on their visit were offering lots of gifts including Daswand in huge numbers. GURU SAHIB was giving his blessings to every Sikh individual to stay focused and believe in Al mighty. During these days one of the sikh follower who was a great fighter said GURU SAHIB, we have so much free time these days as there is no war happening. This is giving lot of boredom in our life and we don’t feel like doing anything. Feels as if enemy has gone somewhere or is sleeping. this doesn’t sound good. On this GURU SAHIB replied "Donot worry. Still there is lot to do. you will find lot of enemies around, Who will not like your wardrobe. They will be feeling bad and will not like you guys because you have left their religion and moved to a new one named as Khalsa. Some will not like you because from "Beeru - Dharmu" you have become "Beer Singh - Dharam Singh". Mughals will not like you because you have rejected their "DEEN...... DE WAADE". You will find many of these kinds of enemies around you all your life. Soon after this one person from the Deewan asked GURU SAHIB, We have collected a lot of precious things like clothes, weapons and cash. but while due to war going on, we couldn't reach Anandpur Sahib and people of Kalmot acted like dacoits and looted every bit of it. We did our best to save it and told them that this is the property of GURU SAHIB, but they completely ignored us. On this GURU SAHIB replied "we have received every bit of present that you guys collected for us. now we will get them from whosoever have it" On this Bhai Alam Singh reacted and said "GURU SAHIB if you give us the permission, should we attack them and get the things back" GURU SAHIB replied "Don’t be in hurry." That night every Singh waited for the next morning. Next day after dewaan, war was declared. GURU SAHIB along with the 100 Singh's reached Kamlot. GURU SAHIB rested under the tree and Singhs attacked the village. Singhs destroyed every house to its bits wherever they find the looted things in the village. After the attack Singhs prepared the dinner and planned to take rest for the night. During night some of the Sikhs planned to attack the nearby fort where most of the villagers were hiding because of the fear of attack. But GURU SAHIB stopped and told to attack in the morning. Next day all the Singhs attacked the fort and started uprooting the walls of Fort. Watching this people who were hiding themselves inside the fort were very clear that their death is for sure and everything will end soon. Therefore, they raised the white flag and started shouting from inside the fort, asking for the mercy from GURU SAHIB. Seeing all this GURU SAHIB called every individual hidden inside the fort and told them not to touch or steal any bodies property and not to disturb anyone while they are on their way while going through/nearby their village. While going to Bibhuor from Kamlot any of the Singhs including Bhai Daya singh requested GURU SAHIB that Before leaving Nirmoh and While leaving Lohgarh you told us that Anandpur sahib is our home now. So now we should move back to Anandpur sahib only. Therefore, everybody rather going to Bibhuor, moved to Anandpur sahib. GURU SAHIB accepted the request and moved to Anandpur sahib. he arranged few people to collect the recovered stuff and sent the same to Anandpur sahib.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Sadabarat Sahib
data.address: Anandpur Sahib Road, Ropar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI SADABARAT SAHIB is situated on the Ropar-Kiratpur Sahib Road in Distt City Ropar.

  • SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SINGH JI came here while coming back from Daroli Bhai ki. GURU SAHIB started the practice of langars at various places and did many of the good things for the benefit of people living in Doaba. Second time SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI came here after winning the battle of Mehraj, Distt Bathinda. GURU SAHIB was going towards Kiratpur Sahib.

  • SHRI GURU HARKARISHAN JI came here while going towards Delhi, he stayed first at this place. Lot of people came to have glimpse of GURU SAHIB.

  • SHRI GURU TEGBAHADUR JI stayed here while going towards and coming back from Bihar-Assam.

  • SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came here while coming from Bihar. Later SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came here many times while going from and coming back to SHRI ANANDPUR SAHIB. Except GURU SAHIB's MATA GUJRI JI, MATA SUNDAR KAUR JI and MATA SAHIB KAUR JI also visited this place.

Earlier, the name of this place was Gurugarh Sahib. The service for this place was organized by Raja Bhup Singh Ji of Ropar. Along with this, he started a 24-hour langar (community kitchen) here, due to which the place came to be known as Sadabarat Sahib.

data.address: Anandpur Sahib, Distt :- Ropar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI SHAHIDI BAGH SAHIB is situated in the Anandpur Sahib of Distt Ropar.

This Oak Tree is of SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI's period. When this tree dry out, congregation(Sangat) requested GURU SAHIB to turn it green again. One day in court(Diwan) GURU SAHIB said that a lady who never scolded a man take bath then the tree would turn green. A lady went for bath and oak turned green. Then GURU JI asked the lady that why she never scolded the man. She narrated her story that she were seven sisters and their father had died and mother was pregnant. Their whole property was seized by government(local authorities) and ordered that if her mother would have a son then they get their property back. By God's grace, her mother gave birth to a male infant and they got back their property. From then, she gave respect to man, as man is a blessing and is disastrous for enemies. GURU SAHIB's Elephant, Parshadi was tied with the same oak tree.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Sheeshganj Sahib
data.address: Anandpur Sahib City, Distt :- Ropar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI SHEESH GANJ SAHIB is situated in the city of SHRI ANANDPUR SAHIB of Ropar Distt.

After martydom of SHRI GURU TEG BAHADUR SAHIB JI martyrdom in Delhi on November 11,1675 a devout sikh BHAI JAITA JI had the honor of bringing the sacred head of SHRI GURU TEG BAHADUR SAHIB JI from Delhi to GURUDWARA BIBANGARH SAHIB at Kiratpur Sahib. He was received by SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI, along with Mata Gujari Ji and Mata Nanaki Ji accompanied by sikhs. The sacred head was placed in a highly decorated and ornate palanquin and brought here at GURUDWARA SHEESH GANJ SAHIB where the sacred head was cremated with full honors. The interior part of the GURUDWARA SAHIB was built under the personal care and supervision of GURU GOBIND SINGH SAHIB, himself.

GURUDWARA SRI AKAL BUNGA SAHIB is situated in the city SHRI ANADPUR SAHIB of Ropar Distt. Situated in the same premises of GURUDWARA SRI SHEESH GANJ SAHIB here SHRI GURU GOBIND SAHIB JI addressed the sikhs after the cremation of sacred head of SHRI GURU TEG BAHADUR SAHIB JI. GURU SAHIB asked the sikhs to bow before the will of the almighty. He told them to be prepared for struggle for freedom of faith and war against injustice.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Suhela Ghora Sahib
data.address: Village :- Ganguwal, Guru Ka Lahore Road, Distt :- Ropar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI SOHELA GHORA SAHIB is situated near the Anandpur Sahib City in Ropar Distt.

Its Situated on the Road Ganguwal- GURDWARA SRI GURU KA LAHORE. Krori Mal, a sikh from Kabul, was a dispile of SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI. He brought two horses for GURU SAHIB, Dilbag & Gulbaag. but Mughal Soldiers in Lahore snatched those horse forcefully. Bhai Karori Mal Ji narrated the incidence to GURU SAHIB in GURDWARA SRI GURUSAR SAHIB SUDHAR, GURU SAHIB accepted there offerings and asked Bhai Bidhi Chand Ji to bring back those horse. Bhai Bidhi Chand Ji brought back both the horses one by one. After which battle in Village Mehraj was fought. GURU SAHIB named them JAAN BHAI & SUHELA. When GURU SAHIB blessed MATA SULAKHANI JI with son, he was sitting on this SUHELA GHORA. GURU SAHIB fought Battle against Mughals in Kartarpur Sahib on this SUHELA GHORA. SUHELA GHORA was wounded in the battle. GURU SAHIB stayed at Nawashahar for at least one month as SUHELA GHORA was undergoing treatment. Later GURU SAHIB started from Nawashahar to Kiratpur Sahib and when they reached this place SUHELA GHORA left for his heavenly aboad. At the time of battle SUHELA GHORA was hit with 600 bullets, and when it was cremated nearly 125 kg of cast metal was found in the body. SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI himself performed ardas and cremated SUHELA GHORA here.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Taari Sahib
data.address: Chamkaur Sahib, Distt :- Ropar, Punjab, India
data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><b>GURUDWARA SHRI TARRI SAHIB</b> is situated at Chamkaur Sahib in Distt Ropar and in the west of GURUDWARA SHRI KATALGARH SAHIB. When <b>SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI</b> decided to leave the Garhi on Hukam of Panj Pyara Sahibs. Along with three Sikhs, Bhai Daya Singh, Bhai Dharam Singh and Bhai Man Singh they left the Garhi. They went in a different direction, promising to meet later at a common place guided by the position of certain stars. Since GURU SAHIB did not wish to leave unannounced, <b>GURU GOBIND SINGH JI</b>, upon reaching the mound where now stands GURUDWARA TARRI (LITERALLY, A CLAP) SAHIB, clapped and shouted: "Here goes the Pir of Hind (the saint of India)!" From their different points the three Sikhs also raised shouts. This baffled the besieging host, and <b>SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI</b> and the Sikhs were soon gone out of harm's way. The GURUDWARA SAHIB situated at the site from where <b>SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI</b> had proclaimed his departure by hand clapping.</p>

By the time he had reached near Shahi Tibbi, covering a distance of about 14 km from Anandpur Sahib, he was overtaken by the pursuers. Bhai Udai Singh, one of the followers saw Sahibzada Ajit Singh ji engaged in battle with Mughals, Then Bhai Udai Singh ji and challenged the mughals and Baba Ajit Singh ji broke there circle and moved forward. while the rest of the column marched on. This was a desperate rearguard action. Bhai Udai Singh and his 50 companions fought valiantly and were killed to a man. The shrine at Shahi Tibbi.</p>

data.address: Patti, Distt :- Tarn Taran, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI BHATH SAHIB is situated in Patti Distt Tarn Taran.

Sangat from Lahore side was bringing Dushale (Shawls) for SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI. But the Mughals had taken those forcefully. When Sangat reached Bhai Ki Daroli, they told GURU SAHIB whole story. GURU SAHIB said that now those Dushales belonged to him and he will himself get them back. GURU SAHIB appointed Bhai Bidi Chand Ji to bring back the dushales. Bhai Bidi Chand Ji reached Patti city. Patti in those days main trading center. Dressed as women Bhai Sahib reached Hakims residence and showed them few dushales he was carrying along with him. Hakims asked there ladies to show him the dushales which they had stolen from sangat to get them evaluated. When they showed the dushales Bhai Bidi Chand Ji took Dushales from them and ran away. In the mean time Hakim got all the doors closed of Patti City. And started searching each and every house of Patti. Bhai Sahib reached a Bhathi and asked him for some place to hide. That person showed Bhai Sahib the Bhathi where fire was going on. Bhai Sahib sat there in Bhathi. On other side GURU SAHIB started asked to pour water on him as his Singh was sitting on fire. With blessing of GURU SAHIB there was no harm to Bhai Bidi Chand Ji.

Bibi Veero ji was daughter of <b>SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI</b> and Mata Damodari Ji. Bibi ji's marriage ceremony took place at this place. Bibi Ji was married to Bhai Sadhu, son of Bhai Dharma resident of Village Malla Distt Faridkot in present Punjab. This GURUDWARA SAHIB is situated on the back side of GURUDWARA SHRI MAI BHAGO JI.</p>

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Chaapri Sahib
data.address: Village :- Chaapri, Distt :- Taran Taaran, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI CHAPRI SAHIB is situated in the Village Chaapri in Distt Tarn Taran.

This GURUDWARA SAHIB is the holy place where SHRI GURU ANGAD DEV JI, SHRI GURU AMAR DAS JI, SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI, SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI, SHRI GURU TEG BAHADUR JI and Makkhan Shah Lubana came while preaching the holy word. This well known as Ath Gutha Khooh (Eight Corners Well) was build under the supervision of SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI. GURU SAHIB blessed this place and said any person who is suffering from athrah disease would be cured if he bath's here on 8 Sundays with a pure heart.

In Khadoor, Jatts had a GURU, a yogi named Shiv Nath. In year 1601, when it failed to rain, Jatts went to SHRI GURU ANGAD DEV JI and pleaded him to bring rain to the area. GURU SAHIB asked them to accept the will of the Almighty. On hearing this Shiv Nath told Jatts to ask GURU SAHIB to bring rain or leave the place. To this GURU SAHIB replied that if his leaving the place would bring rain then he shall leave. GURU SAHIB left Khadoor and came to this place. SHRI (GURU) AMAR DAS JI then accompanied Sangat from Khadoor and pleaded SHRI GURU ANGAD DEV JI to return. Sangat also felt sorry for their foolishness at this place and asked for forgiveness.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Chola Sahib
data.address: Village :- Chola Sahib, Distt :- Tarn Taran, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI CHOHLA SAHIB is situated in the village chohla, 5 km from Sirhali Kalaan in Distt Tarn Taran.

SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI visited this village. The village was called Bhaini when the GURU SAHIB visited here. A housewife served him a delicious dish of chohia, broken bread mixed with sugar and butter (Churi). SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI was pleased and blessed her. He also uttered a hymn of thanks giving with the refrain

"The Lord is our life and soul. He cares for us everywhere in every respect."

"God is our wealth, His Name is our food; this, Nanak, is our chohia."

The village there upon came to be called Chohia Chohia Sahib for the devotees. There are three historical shrines in the village which, it was also visited by SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI. GURDWARA CHOHLA SAHIB at the western edge of the village marks the spot where SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI sat and preached. GURDWARA GURU KI KOTHARI in the interior of the village marks the site of the house where SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI and his wife, Mata Ganga, had stayed. It is also known as MATA GANGAJI DA ASTHAN.

GURDWARA BABA ADALI, in the eastern part of the village, commemorates Bhai Adali, a pious Sikh contemporary of the fourth and the Fifth Gurus, SHRI GURU RAM DAS JI and SHRI GURU ARJAN JI. It was he who brought the famous Bhai Bidhi Chand (d. 1640) into the Sikh fold.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Damdama Sahib
data.address: Goindwal Sahib, Distt :- Tarn Taran, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI DAMDAMA SAHIB is situated in the outer of Goindwal Sahib Distt Tarn Taran.

It is situated on Goindwal Sahib SHRI KHADOOR SAHIB road. Bibi Amro and (GURU) AMAR DAS JI came to pay homage to SHRI GURU ANGAD DEV JI. GURU SAHIB asked them their reason of coming. Bibi ji asked that (GURU) AMARDAS JI has come to asking to let him serve GURU SAHIB. GURU SAHIB gave him the service of bringing water for Langar and other requirements. (GURU) AMAR DAS JI used to fetch water early in the morning from Beas River, GOINDWAL SAHIB for SHRI GURU ANGAD DEV JI"s bathing and other uses. On the way from KHADOOR SAHIB to GOINDWAL SAHIB (GURU) AMAR DAS JI used to stop here under a tree for some time. That Tree is still present here.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Darbar Sahib
data.address: Taran Taaran City, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI TARAN TARAN SAHIB is situated in the Tarn Taran City. Around 1590

Here SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI bought some land and laid the foundation of a GURUDWARA SAHIB in honor of SHRI GURU RAM DAS JI. GURU SAHIB started the excavation of a tank even larger than of GOLDEN TEMPLE. The GURUDWARA SAHIB has one of the largest tanks and resembles the GOLDEN TEMPLE, except that it is built on the side of the tank and has a marble exterior. SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI also established the first home for lepers in India at Tarn Taran.

SHRI GURU AMARDAS JI himself performed Seva of GURDWARA BAOLI SAHIB. GURU SAHIB also appointed 22 Manjis for spreading's messages of Sikhism in different parts of India

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Hargobind Sahib

GURUDWARA SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI is situated in village Sursingh, Teh Patti Distt Tarn Taran Sahib.

Bhai Bhagmal ji offered his newly Built House (Mahal) and 1000 Bigha Jameen to GURU SAHIB and requested to stay there and make use this place to spread message of Sikhism. GURU SAHIB accepted the offering but said he (GURU SAHIB) cannt stay at one place as he has to do lot of things in his life But we promise that one day there will Sikh kendar. Later GURU SAHIB gave this property to Baba Lal Chand ji son of Bhai Bidhi Chand ji and asked him to stay there, take care of every thing and set up sikhism preaching Kendar there(As GURU SAHIB had promised to Bhai Bhagmal ji). From that day onwards Baba Lal Chand ji started living here. Now Baba Daya Singh Ji, from family of Bhai Bidhi Chand ji is staying over here in this village and spreading the message of Sikhism.

Bhai Bidi Chand Ji is remembered for the his daring act of bringing back two horses Gulbag and Dilbag from fort of lahore. Sikh sangat had brought horses for SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI. But Mughals captured those horses. Then GURU SAHIB asked his sangat that who can dare to bring there horses back. data.name: Gurudwara Shri Janam Asthan Bhai Jetha Ji
data.address: Village :- Sidhwan, Teh :- Patti, Distt :- Taran Taaran, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI JANAM ASTHAAN BHAI JETHA JI SAHIB is situated in the village Sidhwan, Teh Patti, Distt Taran Taaran Sahib.

Here Bhai Jetha Ji was Born in Samat 1611 (1554 BC) to Bhai Sand Ji and Mata Karmi Ji. Bhai Jetha had honer of serving SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI and SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI. Bhai Jetha Ji took part in the excavation of the sacred pool at Amritsar (SHRI HARIMANDIR SAHIB) and the construction of the Harimandir Sahib. He was one of the five Sikhs who accompanied SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI on his last journey to Lahore where GURU SAHIB met a martyr's death in 1606. He was accompanied by four sikhs, Bhai Bidhi Chand Ji, Bhai Langah Ji, Bhai Paira Ji and Bhai Pirana Ji. These Sikhs were witness to the events leading to the GURU SAHIB's martyrdom. They Came back to Amritsar and narrated to SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI and the Sikhs what had happened in Lahore. Bhai Jetha and the other four received training in the fighting skills and were appointed by SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI to lead a troop of one hundred horsemen each. He accompanied the GURU SAHIB to Delhi and was in attendance upon him during his detention in the Fort of Gwalior. When GURU SAHIB refused to eat the food provided by the Fort Authorities Bhai Jetha Ji used to work in Gwalior and bring food for GURU SAHIB from his earnings. He took part in battles against the imperial troops, and fell fighting at Mehraj (Bhathinda)on 16 December 1634.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Janam Asthan Baba Deep Singh Ji
data.address: Village :- Pahuvind, Teh :- Patti, Distt :- Tarn Taran, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI JANAM ASTHAN BABA DEEP SINGH JI SAHIB is situated in the village Pahuvind Teh Patti Distt Tarn Taran.

BABA DEEP SINGH JI was born on 26th January 1682 to Father Bhai Bagtu ji and Mata Jeoni ji. At the age of eighteen, he received Amrit from the Panj Pyare at Anandpur Sahib on Vaisakhi day and took an oath to serve as one of Waheguru’s warriors (Akal Purakh dee fauj). With his new name, Deep Singh also learned that Sikhs are to always help the weak and needy, and to fight for truth and justice. After receiving the vows of the Khalsa, he stayed on in Anandpur to continue his studies of the sacred texts under Bhai Mani Singh. He soon became one of the Guru's most beloved Sikhs staying in Anandpur for a total of about eight years. BABA DEEP SINGH JI was the leader of the famous " Shaheedan Di Missel " among the 12 missels. Apart from getting the GURU GRANTH SAHIB'S saroop written, he also actively participated in all the major battles that took place in the 18th century. In the year 1757 when BABA DEEP SINGH JI got the news that Taimurshah & Jahan Khan have shown disrespect for SHRI DARBAR SAHIB and also started filling the holy sarovar, even though BABA JI was in old age he carried a 18 ser heavy Khanda in his hand to free SHRI DARBAR SAHIB. He took pledge to teach a lesson to the cruel and started his journey for SHRI AMRITSAR SAHIB. On hearing this, Jahan Khan had made thousands of his soldiers ready on the outskirts of the town near Gohalvadh village. There was a fierce battle. BABA JI was still far from the town when during his battle with Jahan Khan, he was beheaded. A Singh standing close to BABA JI when reminded him of his pledge, such a miracle happened which has never happened in the world before. BABA JI held his head in his left hand and with his right hand he swayed the Khanda with such a force that the enemies started running. Like this, fighting the fierce battle, BABA JI reached SHRI AMRITSAR & offered his head at SHRI HARMANDAR SAHIB. In Parkarma, at Shaheed Bunge, this GURUDWARA reminds one of BABA JI & acts as a source of inspiration to keep alive the holiness of such places.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Jhulane Mahal Sahib
data.address: Village :- Thathi Khara, Distt :- Tarn Taran, Punjab, India

GURUDWARA SHRI JHULANE MAHAL SAHIB is situated in the Village Thathi Khara, Distt Tarn Taran.

SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI was monitoring the excavation of Holy Tank at Tarn Taran. And at Night time GURU SAHIB used to come here for rest. GURU SAHIB used to hold daily preaching over here. Once religious diwan was going on. People were listening to GURU SAHIB. on the back side there was Army going on, In which there were Elephants, Horse's and Soldiers. People were looking on the Back side. When GURU SAHIB asked what were they looking at, People said we were looking on swinging elephants, GURU SAHIB told them that this was live animals, but your Mahals will swing for lives. Now there's wall, When we try to move it, it swings in actual.

data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI MAI BHARAI SAHIB is situated in the Khadoor Sahib City in Distt Tarn Taran.

SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI also blessed this place by visiting here. In Kartapur SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI made Bhai Lehna Ji the second GURU and instructed him to preach Gurmat. SHRI GURU ANGAD DEV JI came to this place and started meditating here after instructing Mai Bharai Ji not to divulge his where about to anyone. When Sangat could not find GURU SAHIB they came here along with BABA BUDHA JI. BABA BUDHA JI requested SHRI GURU ANGAD DEV JI to appear before Sangat. SHRI GURU ANGAD DEV JI stayed in this home for 6 months and 6 days.

Langar was prepared Mata Khivi Ji with her own hands. The Langar comprised of Kheer. Here GURU SAHIB taught Gurmukhi script to children. First school of Gurmukhi was also started here. Emperor Hamayun also came here to seek blessings of GURU SAHIB. Here SHRI GURU ANGAD DEV JI also used to organized wrestling matches of children, hence it is called GURUDWARA MAL AKHARA SAHIB.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Mar Jiwala Sahib
data.address: Village :- Tanda, Kicha, Distt :- Udham Singh Nagar, Uttrakhand, India
data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><b>GURUDWARA SHRI MAR JIWALA SAHIB</b> is situated in the Village Tanda, Kicha, Distt Udham Singh Nagar, Uttrakhand. GURUDWARA SAHIB can be reached from Rudarpur (Distt. Head of Udham Singh Nagar) and Kicha. <b>SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI </b>came here on the request of Bhai Hara ji, with GURU SAHIB's order Bhai Bala ji and Mardana ji stayed undercover for some time. GURU SAHIB transformed himself into a child and sat there. Ruhela Pathaan caught GURU SAHIB (Child) and he sold GURU SAHIB (Child) to another merchant. When merchant who bought GURU SAHIB (Child) asked GURU SAHIB (Child) to graze the Sheeps. On this GURU SAHIB (Child) told the merchant that if he will touch any of the sheep with his stick, she will die there and then. Merchant wanted to make sure if this is true, so he insisted GURU SAHIB (Child) to do the same. And soon when Guru Sahib (Child) touched the sheep, she died.(Now GURUDWARA SHRI MAR JIWALA SAHIB is situated at this sacred place). When GURU SAHIB touched the dead Sheep with his stick once again, she regained her senses and life again. </p>

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Sant Sagar Baoli Sahib
data.address: Village :- Gaindakhata, Haridwar - Nazibabad Road, Distt :- Haridwar, Uttrakhand, India
data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><b>GURUDWARA SANT SAGAR BAOLI SAHIB</b> is situated in the Village Gendikhatha, Distt Haridwar, Uttrakhand. Its 20 km from Haridwar on Nazibabad Road. In 1565, <b>SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI</b> after visiting Nanakmata, Kashipur, Kotdwar and Naziabad came to this sacred place in the month of July-Aug. At that time GURU SAHIB was of 40 years of age. <b>SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI</b> spent 3 months and 13 days while doing meditation here. During these days GURU SAHIB presented a gift of Amrit in the form of Bauli sahib to the local people and even today they are enjoying the water of this Bauli Sahib. This place was a Khatri garden. The Khatri came to his garden and saw the three saints and bowed down in front of them . Then he started visiting every day. One day a Mannmukh asked Khatri where he was going. Khatri said that he goes to the forest to visit <b> Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji </b> Manmukh asked if he can also come along, they both walked together. On the way, Manmukh went to the house of a prostitute. Khatri went to see <b>Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji </b> Both of them advised that whoever comes first should come to this place and wait for the other one. In this way for some time Khatri kept going to see Guru Sahib and Munnmukh kept going to do evil deeds at prostitute's house. One day Manmukh went to the house of a prostitute and she was not at home. He came back sad and started waiting for Khatri at decided place. Manmukh sat down and started digging the ground, then he found a Gold coin The Khatri, on the other hand, was returning from a visit to Guru Sahib a thorn got stuck in the foot and he reached the spot limping. Manmukh laughed and said, "Dear Khatri, you used to associate with Sants. Sants crippled you and I used to go to do evil deeds and I have found a Gold Coin." What is the reason for this? Khatri Pyare said let's go and ask Guru Sahib. Both went to Guru Sahib and asked their question <b>Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji </b> and Bala Mardana Ji got up and walked to the place where they had found the Gold Coin. Guru Sahib asked Manmukh to dig there. A pot was found after digging the ground In which were extinguished charcoal. Then Guru Sahib said Manmukh you had given a Gold coin donation to a saint in the previous life and that donation was increasing and this vessel was full. When you started committing evil deeds in this life, all these Gold coins became coal. And on other side when thorn stuck in his foot he was to be crucified at that time, but due to the company of Sants, he got thorn stuck in his foot. From this place Guru Sahib went to Haridwar. GURDWARA SAHIB is situated on the Haridwar-Najibabad Road at the Bridge Toll Barrier. </p>

With the instructions of SHRI GURU ANGAD DEV JI, the Janam Sakhi of SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI was written here by Bhai Bala Ji. data.name: Gurudwara Shri Bibangarh Sahib
data.address: Fatehgarh Sahib City, Punjab, India
data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><b>GURUDWARA SHRI BIBANGARH SAHIB</b> is situated in the Distt City Fatehgarh Sahib. Its situated on the back side of GURUDWARA SHRI FATEHGARH SAHIB. In 1704, Sahibzada Zorawar Singh and Sahibzada Fateh Singh ji were martyred mercilessly. After their martyrdom Bhai Moti Ram Mehra ji narrated the whole incident to Mata Gujri Ji. After listening this Mata Gujri prayed before god and left his holy abode. Mughals threw their dead bodies in dense forest behind GURUDWARA SHRI FATEHGARH SAHIB, on bank of River Hansla. The forest contains many wild animals. One Lion guarded the holy bodies for 48 hours from other animals. Suba Demanded gold coins from Diwan Todar Mal and Sangat for cremation of those pious bodies. It marks the place where dead bodies of the three martyrs were kept for the night, and their hearses prepared prior to cremation. </p>

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Banda Ghaat Sahib
data.address: Nanded City, Maharashtra, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI BANDA GHAAT SAHIB is situated in Distt City Nanded, Maharashtra.

When SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came to the Deccan along with the Mughal Emperor, Bahadur Shah He came here to Madho Das’ hut. Madho Das was away. He had learnt Tantra and was locally famous for his occult powers. He attempted to conjure his magic to humiliate GURU SAHIB, but his magic would not prevail on GURU SAHIB. Defeated he fell at the GURU SAHIB's feet GURU SAHIB asked him "Who are you?". Madho Das replied "i am Banda". GURU SAHIB asked "whose Banda?". Madho das replied "Your's". GURU SAHIB soon gave Banda the title of Bahadur. Banda was baptized and converted into the Sikh fold. GURU SAHIB gave him five arrows and sent him to Punjab to fight against the Mughals. He is popularly known as "Banda Bahadhur".

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Janam Asthan Bhagat Namdev Ji
data.address: Village :- Narsi Namdev, Distt :- Hingoli, Maharashtra, India
data.description:
GURDWARA SRI JANAM ASTHAN BHAGAT NAMDEV JI SAHIB is situated in Village Narsi Namdev, Distt Hingoli, Maharashtra.

Bhagat Namdev Ji was born here to Mata Goni Bai and Father Dama Seth in 1270. Bhagat Namdev ji spent his child hood in this village. Bhagat Ji was from Chhimba caste which is treated as lower caste in India by Pandits / Brahmins. Bhagat Ji was follower of Lord Vitthal (Krishna). His father used to offer parshad to daily God. One day he had to go to a distant village in the midst of business. That duty was given to Bhagat Namdev Ji. Bal Namdev ji and went to Kesari Raj ji's temple and performed Yatha Shakti Puja with great devotion and placed the plate in front of idol. There was no movement in the statue of Lord. It seemed to Namdev ji that there was a great disaster, Bhagwan ji can takes parshad every day and it is was not happening today. Bhagat ji offered many prayers to God, but still God did not give parshad. Bhagat ji warned that if you do not take parshad from my hand and milk from the bowl, then I will give up my life here. Seeing Bhagatji's devotion, God took a material form and drank milk. Bhagat Ji's Guru Visoba Khechar lived at Aundha Nagnath Temple, who introduced Bhagat Ji to Nirgun Prameshar. Once Namdev jI went to Aundha Nagnath Temple. The Hindu priests of that temple believed in the caste system, after reaching the temple, Namdev Ji sat and started worshipping the God but the Hindu priests grabbed his arm dragged him out of the temple. The priests said that Namdev Ji could not worship in the temple because he was from a low caste. Namdev Ji was deeply hurt so he went to the back of the temple and started worshipping God. In his prayer he said: "Joyfully, I came to Your Temple, O Lord. While Namdev Ji was worshipping, he was driven out. I am of a lower caste, O Lord; why was I born in the family of fabric dyers? I picked up my blanket and went back, to sit behind the temple" Namdev also said: "O Lord, please do not forget me because if You forget me then where should I go. There is nowhere else to go and no one else to believe in except You." He further prayed: "Please do not forget me, do not forget me, please do not forget me, O Lord. The temple priests have doubts about this, and everyone is furious with me. Calling me low-caste and untouchable, they beat me and dragged me out, what should I do now ? If You give me salvation after I am dead, no one will know that I attained salvation. These Priests, these religious scholars, call me low-born, when they say this, they tarnish Your honor as well. You are called kind and compassionate, the power of Your Arm is absolutely unrivalled". "As Namdev uttered the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the temple turned around to face the Lord's humble devotee". "The Lord turned the temple around to west to face Namdev and its back to the priests". That temple is still rotated as can be seen at the site. In most Hindu temples, the water pool is normally located at the front of the mandir, at this site, it can be seen at the back of the temple. Further, most temples face east since that is the most auspicious direction in the Hindu faith as the Sun rises from the East and the Sun is considered the destroyer of darkness and the giver of life.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Ghaat Sahib
