data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI GHAAT SAHIB is situated in the Village Tanda, Kicha, Distt Udham Singh Nagar, Uttrakhand.

GURUDWARA SAHIB can be reached from Rudarpur (Distt. Head of Udham Singh Nagar) and Kicha. SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI came here on the request of Bhai Hara ji, with GURU SAHIB's order Bhai Bala ji and Mardana ji stayed undercover for some time. GURU SAHIB transformed himself into a child and sat there. Ruhela Pathaan caught GURU SAHIB (Child) and he sold GURU SAHIB (Child) to a third merchant. When merchant who bought GURU SAHIB (Child) asked GURU SAHIB (Child) to fetch water from well. The pitcher that GURU SAHIB (Child) got to fetch the water from the well was 1 feet above than GURU SAHIB\"s (Child) head. GURU SAHIB (Child) asked Khwaza Khizar not to give water without GURU SAHIB's order. Soon after this all the well went dry. Merchant send GURU SAHIB (Child) to River Bank(GHat), but it was also dry(Today GURUDWARA SHRI GHAT SAHIB is situated at this sacred place). On this Pathan's of nearby area assembled together in a Masjid (Mosque) where GURU SAHIB (Child) told all of them that "If you stop Human Trade with effect from now, only then the Khuda (God) will listen to your prayers. After this all the Pathan's said "NO" to the bad deeds and human trade thereafter. GURU SAHIB (Child) asked Khwaza Khizar to give the water again, soon all the rivers and wells of the nearby area were flooded with ample amount of water. After seeing this wonder of GURU SAHIB (Child), all the pathaans felt the greatness of GURU SAHIB\"s (Child); all fell in his feet and asked to forgive them. Thats how GURU SAHIB preached all the pathaan's of this area including Ruhela Pathaan and blessed Bhai Hara Singh Ji with a new name "Kalyaan Singh".

It marks the site where the SHRI GURU TEGBAHADUR SAHIB JI was beheaded on the orders of the Mughal emperor Aurangzeb on 11 November 1675 for refusing to convert to Islam. In front of Gurudwara Sahib is place where Bhai Mati Das Ji, Bhai Sati Das Ji and Bhai Dyala Ji were also executed in front of GURU SAHIB. When SHRI GURU TEGBAHADUR JI was beheaded here, no one dared to pick GURU SAHIBS SACRED HEAD and his body. But with wish of akal purakh, swear storm swept through the city. Under the cover of dark blanket Bhai Jaita ji managed to escape with GURU SAHIBS SACRED HEAD to Punjab. GURU SAHIB's body was lies on the spot. One of GURU SAHIB devotees Bhai Lakhi Shah at his personal risk managed to take away GURU SAHIBS body to his house (Place where GURUDWARA SHRI RAKAB GANJ SAHIB is situated). To cremate it openly would have led to detection, So he set fire to his house there by cremating the body in the traditional way.

data.address: Village :- Sathiala, Teh :- Baba Bakala, Distt :- Amritsar, Punjab, India

GURUDWARA SHRI NANASAR SAHIB is situated in village Sathiala, Teh Baba Bakala, Distt Amritsar.

SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI stayed in majha area for many months preaching people of this area. GURU SAHIB came here while going from Sultanpur Lodhi to Gurdaspur. In those day this village was known as Muglani and in this village was ruled by Mughals. Mughals had strong fort in this village. In Hazipur Area of this village, Hazi Fakir used to stay. He was Raja Janaks cook in his previous life and because of curse he was born as muslim. He used to tell people that he has many magical powers. He never allowed any fakir to enter or stay in this village. He used to tell people that he has direct connection with GOD. To break his mith SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI came to this village and sat near pond. Along with GURU SAHIB was Bhai Bala and Bhai Mardana Ji, They started singing shabad. A muslim lady when heard this kirtan came to GURU SAHIB with child who was sick. When after sometime GURU SAHIB opened his eyes, He understood the ladies prayer and asked to have this child take bath in this pond. Bathing in this pond is equal to bathing in 68 Holy places. Bhai Mardana ji made the child to bath in pond. After bath child was feeling healthy. Watching this lady fell on GURU SAHIB and Bhai Mardana Ji's feet. Lady told everyone in village that a true fakir is sitting near village Pond, Everyone else is liar. GURU SAHIB told everyone that who so ever will take bath in this pond, his/her wishes will come true.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Mata Ganga Ji Sahib
data.address: Baba Bakala, Distt :- Amritsar, Punjab, India
data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><B>GURUDWARA SHRI MATA GANGA JI SAHIB</B> is situated in Baba Bakala Distt Amritsar. When <B>SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI</B> was going to Lahore then his wife Mata Ganga Ji asked, When will we get chance to see you again. Then GURU SAHIB replied that you wont be able to see him again in this body, We will meet spiritually. When Mata Ganga Ji's end time arrived she instructed that her body shouldn't be cremated but it should submitted to water. After some time Mata Ganga Ji passed away. According to her instructions her son <B>SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI</B> and sangat took Mata Ji's Body on bier (Biban, A wooden structure for carrying dead body) to River Beas near by in highly decorated way, On the way Sangat kept rhyming Shabads. River Beas is approx two km from Baba Bakala. There they placed mata ji Body at a platform, That place now is known as Gurudwara Shri Bibangarh Sahib. GURU SAHIB instructed to four people carrying Bier (Biban Mata Ji's body) to take it into deep water. When they took body to water and water level was at their above their waste they saw that there was no body over there. GURU SAHIB asked them to come back and cremated that Biban here at Baba Bakala. GURU SAHIB told that few people from this world will leave to sachkhand with Body.</p>

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Patshahi Dasvin Sahib
data.address: Village :- Bajak, Distt :- Bathinda, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI PATSHAHI DASVIN SAHIB is situated in Village Distt Bathinda.

SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came here from Shri Mukatsar Sahib. After battle of Mukatsar Sahib GURU SAHIB came here at Bajak while preaching at different places. When people came to know about GURU SAHIB they came with lot of milk. When people came to know about GURU SAHIB they came with lot of milk. Singhs along with GURU SAHIB drank milk, But one Singh Rai Singh didnt drink it. On Sangats complaint, GURU SAHIB asked Bhai Rai SIngh, He told that these people are thief, who bring the grazing animals forcefully. And afraid of them, owner does not follow. The newly Born calf dies without mothers milk. When GURU SAHIB asked Villagers about this, They agreed to this. GURU SAHIB asked Bhai Daya Singh that from now onward they will not hurt any poor villagers, There will no shortage of Milk in this village.

A sadhu from divana sect tried to meet GURU SAHIB at different locations, But couldn't. Finally When GURU SAHIB was resting at Village Maluka, He came there and argued with Singhs guarding GURU SAHIB, In the argument, he got wounded. When GURU SAHIB came to know about this, he took his head in his lap and asked his wish, He said he had only on wish to have your glimpse, Now as he had that he just want to leave this world. When people from divana sect came to know about his death, they wanted to take revenge. Sukhu and Budhu, two sadhus of same Divana sect from nearby Ghuda village, came for this. But as soon as came in front of GURU SAHIB, anger was gone out of their hearts. They sang local song for GURU SAHIB. Further they requested GURU SAHIB that they want to carry GURU SAHIB like Bhai Gani Khan and Bhai Nabi Khan carried GURU SAHIB on bed. Accepting their request GURU SAHIB dressed in blue, Sukhu and Budhu along with other Singhs carried GURU SAHIB on bed to near by Village called Guru Kot. GURUDWARA SHRI PATSHAHI DASVIN SAHIB, GURU KOT is situated there.

data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI DARBAR SAHIB KARTARPUR SAHIB is situated in Village Shakargarh, Distt Narowal, Punjab, Pakistan.

SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI after his missionary udasis settled here. While living here GURU SAHIB did farming for 18 years (rest of his life). Here SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI gave principles of "Kirat Karo, Naam Japo, Wand Shako". Which means one should earn his livelihood by honest way and hard work. One should Devote his time for God and One should share with needy as per requirements. GURU SAHIB wrote ASA DI WAR, REHRAAS SAHIB and many more paath here. Bhai Lehna Ji served GURU SAHIB for seven years and was blessed with GURDADDI here. After Gurgaddi he became SRI GURU ANGAD DEV JI and went to Khadoor Sahib on SRI GURU NANAK DEV JI'S instruction. When SRI GURU NANAK DEV JI left for heavenly aboad, there was conflict between Sikh/Hindus and Muslim followers. Muslims insisted that he was their Muslim Peer so his body should be buried according to Muslim rituals and Sikh/Hindus were insisting on doing cremation according to Hindu/Sikh rituals. When this conflict grew a wise man came and asked the reason. Then he said let us perform a Ardas and ask GURU SAHIB for help. After ardas when covering sheet was removed from GURU SAHIB's body, there were flowers lying. On wise man's advice they divided flowers in two parts. Muslim buried those flowers and Sikh/Hindus cremated flowers. Both the memorials exist next to each other. This Gurudwara Sahib is only four km from GURUDWARA SHRI DERA BABA NANAK, DERA BABA NANAK, INDIA. In 2019 Pakistan Govt opened a special corridor for Indian Sangat who can come and have darshan without any Visa requirement.


Link for Booking Yatra for Indian Sangat :- www.prakashpurb550.mha.gov.in

Putting the basket under the shade of Bheri here, she went to Tung village to get Prasada etc., then her husband saw a wonderful sight that black crows used to come out in the sarovar like Toby Lake swan. Seeing all this, he took a dip in the sarovar with the support of the beri root By the grace of Guru, her body was healed. When the matter came to the notice of <b>SHRI GURU RAM DAS JI</b> who was serving Santokhar, he dispelled the suspicion and said, Bibi as per your devotion and determination and due to the power of this place your Pingala husband got cured. data.name: Gurdwara Sri Kirpan Bhet Sahib
data.address: Machiwara, Distt :- Ludhiana, Punjab, India
data.description:
<p style="text-align: justify;"><B>GURDWARA SRI KIRPAN BHET SAHIB</B> is situated in the Machiwara town of Ludhiana Distt. After Martyrdom of his two Sahibjadas and few sikhs <B>SRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI</B> left the fort of SRI CHAMKAUR SAHIB and reached here in jungles of Machiwara. Bhai Daya Singh Bhai Dharam Singh and Bhai Man Singh also reached here according to GURU SAHIB's instruction given at Chamkaur Sahib. In the morning they took bath and started reciting Path. By the time care taker of the fields Mahi came here and saw GURU SAHIB and Sikhs, He informed to Gulabe and Punjabe the owners of these fields. They requested GURU SAHIB and took him to their house. Their they served GURU SAHIB with great devotion. Horse trader brothers Bhai Gani Khan and Nabi Khan were also from this village. They requested GURU SAHIB to visit their home, But further also requested that as there were lot of Mughal informers in the area, so they requested that if GURU SAHIB can come in a blue dress as UCH SHAREEF DA PEER, then it would be easy for them to serve. (Because even today, all the Sufi monks of Uch Shareef, Distt Bahawalpur (Pakistan) don't cut their hairs and wear blue clothes.) A dyer was called upon and GURU SAHIB ordered him to color the clothes. GURDWARA SRI CHAUBARA SAHIB exists on that place By the time the news that GURU SAHIB was in Machiwara spreaded. Mughal soldiers surrounded Machiwara in large numbers. Dilawar Khan was leading one unit of Soldiers. While starting for Punjab he prayed in front of Uch Shareef Da peer that his soldiers may not have to face <B>SRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI</B>, He will offer Peer ji 500 Gold coins. <BR /><BR />
			Further it was discussed that GURU SAHIB can escape the from Machiwara as Uch Da Peer. After staying for two days at Gani Khan and Nabi Khans House GURU SAHIB left for further. GURU SAHIB was sitting on bed and Bhai Gani Khan Nabi Khan were carrying from front and Bhai Daya Singh Ji and Bhai Dharam Singh from Behind. When they reached on outskirts of Machiwara (at this place) Mughal soldiers stopped them and asked who He is. Bhai Gani Khan Nabi Khan told that he is our “Uch Shareef Da peer” and going  to sacred places. Dilawar Khan said he cannot let your peer sahib to move ahead without getting him identified. In the meanwhile, you may have breakfast with us. Bhai Gani Khan Nabi Khan said peer ji is on fast, but we followers can have food with you. Bhai Daya Singh Ji Bhai Dharam Singh Ji requested GURU SAHIB that what should they do, GURU SAHIB gave them a small dagger (Kirpan) and told them to swipe this in the food before having it and not to worry about anything. When food was served Bhai Daya Singh Ji and Bhai Dharam Singh ji did the same. A soldier of Dilawar Khan asked what they were doing, Bhai Gani Khan Nabi Khan told that they have just received message from Makka to offer food to Dagger (kirpan) first. In the meanwhile, Peer Muhamad Kazi from Nurpur also reached there on instruction of Dilawar Khan. When he saw GURU SAHIB he told Dilawar Khan that you should be thankful that Peer ji had not cursed your stopping him. Dilawar Khan allowed GURU SAHIB to leave. GURU SAHIB reminded Dilawar khan of his wish to not to face <B>SRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI</B> army for which he had promised 500 coins. Listening this Dilawar Khan fully satisfied and offered 500 coins and shawl to GURU SAHIB and asked to forgive him. GURU SAHIB gave those coins to Bhai Gani Khan and Nabi Khan. From then onward offering food and Prashad to Kirpan started which is still going on.</p>

data.name: Gurdwara Sri Gian Godri Sahib
data.address: Har Ki Paudi, Haridwar, Uttrakhand, India
data.description:
SRI GURU NANAK DEV JI while on his eastward journey reached Haridwar. It is a big city in Uttarakhand, on the banks of the river Ganges and is one of the major centers for Hindu pilgrimage. The people, gathered there in large numbers, were bathing in the holy river. SRI GURU NANAK DEV JI observed many people throwing water towards the sun in the east. These people who were offering handfuls of water from river Ganges, towards the sun in the east, believed that by this ritual they could offer water to their dead elders in the next world. This next world was in the East from where the Sun rose. SRI GURU NANAK DEV JI entered the river for purposes of bathing as other common pilgrims were doing. Instead of throwing water to the east, he, however, started throwing water in the opposite direction towards the west where GURU SAHIB farm was. Taking him as a new visitor, the nearby bathers told him that he was not performing the rituals correctly. They advised him to throw water to the east. Guru Sahib continued throwing water towards the west pretending that he was very much absorbed in the 'holy' act and had not heard anything. Soon, many people gathered there to tell him the proper method of performing the ritual. His water thrown to the west was of no use to him or to his dead ancestors. The leader of the pilgrims approached and asked GURU SAHIB, “Why are you throwing the holy water to the West in the wrong direction?” By this time many thousand of bather were watching GURU SAHIB. "The water is to be thrown towards the rising sun in the east so that it reaches your dead ancestors."

GURU SAHIB calmly replied, “I am watering my crops in Punjab. All my crops in my village are dying as there has been no rain” and continued to splash the water to the west. He wanted to irrigate those crops. Hearing GURU SAHIB reply the people started laughing.

The curious spectators asked, “Are you crazy? How can your water reach hundreds of miles away to Punjab from here?” GURU SAHIB replied, “The very same way as yours reaches your ancestors in the other world many millions of miles away. In fact, my farm is quite closer on this very earth." GURU SAHIB stopped splashing the water. GURU SAHIB became serious and asked, "If the water thrown by me cannot reach a few hundred miles away on this very earth, how can water thrown by you to your dead ancestors reach them in the heavens?" The leader of the pilgrims had no answer to this. The people became silent and started thinking over the reply given by the GURU SAHIB. They had no logical argument to challenge his statement. This made the people think about the uselessness of their ritual. SRI GURU NANAK DEV JI came out of the river and the crowd followed him. The GURU SAHIB calmly told them the truth. He explained that hollow rituals do not have any religious value. They should love, respect and take care of their people, friends and religions when they are alive rather then perform these useless rituals afterward. When people die, they do not need anything from us and neither can we send them anything after they have left this world. After death, people get what they have given to the needy, out of their honest earnings, while living on this earth.

NOTE :- We could not find any place marked or reserved or preserved as GURDWARA SAHIB in remembrance of GURU SAHIB at Har ki Pauri in Haridwar. What we find was only a room on the name of SRI GURU NANAK DEV JI, managed by Mahants, Gurdwara Sri Gyan Godri Sahib, was one of the Sacred Place at Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar, Uttarakhand. It existed at the place where The Bharat Scouts and Guides office exists today at the market in Subhash Ghat of Har Ki Pauri which is verified by Municipal Corporation Haridwar records of 1935

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Dhana Bhagat Ji Sahib

data.description:
<p style="text-align: justify;"><B>GURUDWARA SHRI BHAGAT DHANA JI SAHIB</B> is located in village Dhuan Kalan, District Tonk, Rajasthan Bhagat Dhanna Ji is one of those Bhagats whose Bani is included in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Bhagat Dhanna ji was born in village Dhuan Kalan to mother Ganga Bai and father Ramesh Das. Bhagat Dhanna ji's main occupation was farming. Bhagat ji had a very naive nature and divine love from his childhood. Being religiously inclined, he used to listen to the life stories of pious men from the elders of the village. He had heard a lot about the lives of Bhagat Kabir ji, Bhagat Ravidas ji, Bhagat Sain ji, Bhagat Namdev etc. Due to which the desire to worship also arose in his mind. Due to this desire and divine attraction, he became a disciple of Swami Rama Nand, a resident of Kashi and started worshiping Sargun Saroop in the early stages. A Brahmin named Trilochan lived in Bhagat Dhanna ji's village He was also a worshiper of Sargun. According to his daily deeds, he used to worship Thakur (a stone) every day. Bhagat Dhanna ji used to visit him often while going to his fields. One day Bhagat ji asked Pandit Trilochan for a Thakur. At first the Pandit tried to evade, but at Bhagat Ki's repeated urgings, the Pandit took other stone in his house, wrapped it in a simple robe, grabbed him and explained the whole ritual. Bhagat ji was very happy to get Thakur (stone) and brought it to his well. According to the method prescribed by the Pandit, Bhagat ji bathed Thakur and engaged in the ritual service. Began to sing the praises of Thakur ji with full devotion and true devotion. Meanwhile, bread and lassi reached Bhagat ji from his house. Bhagat ji started offering food to Thakur ji before eating, according to the maryada prescribed by the Pandit and started requesting for bhog. This was a traditional practice of the Pandit But Bhagat ji believed this to be true and waited for the Lord to give him food<BR><BR>


			This went on for many days Due to not eating Thakur ji's food, Bhagat Dhanna ji kept begging like children every day. Seeing Bhagat ji's true devotion and faith, God appeared there and made Bhagat Dhanna ji happy by seeing him and tasted the food. There was no limit to Bhagat ji's happiness due to the vision of the Lord. Bhagat ji became self-aware and possessed the supreme position According to the story, out of love, the Lord dug the well of Bhagat Dhanna ji himself, grazed cows and buffaloes and also plowed. Like Bhagat ji has subdued the Lord due to his love and devotion. Hearing the news of this incident, Pandit Trilochan also started begging Bhagat ji to attain Prabhu Darshan. Bhagat ji requested the Lord to give Darshan to the Pandit but the Lord did not give Darshan because the devotion of Pandit Trilochan was not true and was traditional. Seeing that the vision of the Lord was not achieved, Pandit Ji's heart was also purified, The mountain of ego had vanished from the mind and had become a complete refuge of the Lord. The people of this area consider the land around the shrine to be very sacred and refrain from defecating in this land.</p>

data.address: Opposite Indian Overseas Bank, Pushkar, Distt :-Ajmer, Rajasthan, India
data.description:
<p style="text-align: justify;"><B>GURUDWARA SHRI SINGH SABHA SAHIB</B> is situated in Pushkar City, Distt Ajmer, Rajasthan. This place is hindu religious center. This city is located arround the beutifull lake. And there are 52 Ghats (Point of Worship). From those 52 one is known as GOBIND GHAT and is related to Sikh History. <b> SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI</b> came here to Ajmer and Pushkar in 1511 while coming back from Sri Lanka. Coming through Marwar GURU SAHIB reached in Ajmer and had discussion with Alauddin Chisti, who was follower of Muslim Peer Chisti Sahib. After having religious discussions GURU SAHIB came here to Pushkar. Here Guru Sahib met the sages and told them the truth. Guru Sahib persuaded them to serve humanity. Guru Sahib also instructed the construction of a dharamsala and a langar.<BR><BR>
			<b>SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI </b> came here while going to Nanded from Talwandi Sabo. GURU SAHIB came here from Dadu Dwara, Naraina. Guru Sahib also rested at the same place where <b> SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI </b> sat. A Brahmin by the name of Chetan, met <b> SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI </b> and told him about the place where <b> SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI </b> was sitting. GURU SAHIB gave a hukamnama to Brahman Chetan, which is still with his family. It is signed by GURU SAHIB. Sangat can see it. When the locals saw the Khalsa, they asked about his attire. They were amazed that they had hairs and that they had weapons also. They are neither Hindus nor Muslims. Guru Sahib told them that he had started a new Panth known as the Khalsa Panth. Which is different from Hindus and Muslims. They are the priests of Akal Purakh. People asked if they were small, then Guru Sahib told them that they were just seeds. Khalsa will grow out of them. From here GURU SAHIB left for further and reached Bagor. There GURU SAHIB came to know about death of Aurangzeb.</p>

data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><B>GURUDWARA SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI SAHIB</B> is located in Pokhran City, District Jaisalmer, Rajasthan. While teaching the mankind <B>SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI</B> reached Gorakhmatta (Now known as Nanakmatta) and has discussions with Sidh's. After preaching to the Sidhs, Guru Sahib flew to Pokhran Bhai Mardana Ji said, "Guru Sahib, I am hungry." Guru Sahib pointed to Aak plant and asked to eat as much as you can." Bhai Mardana Ji said Guru Sahib, this is Aak Plant, why are you joking with me? Then Guru Sahib said, we are not joking. You can eat as much as you want by saying Sat Kartar, but don't be greedy. and dont pack for yourself. Bhai Mardana ji started to eat, gradually he was getting taste of nector. Bhai Mardana ji ate khakris a lot and at the same time became greedy and packed for further also. The next day, when he got hungry again, he quietly took some and started eating khakris again. Shortly after the meal, he started feeling unrest. Guru Sahib laughed when he saw this. Bhai Mardana Ji said Guru Sahib I am dying and you are laughing. Then Guru Sahib said that Mardana i had told you not to pack, and if you had to eat, you would have taken permission before eating. Then Guru Sahib plucked with his own hand and fed it to a mardana ji. After eating them, Bhai Mardana Ji recovered and Guru Sahib walked towards his next destination.</p>

data.name: Gurudwara Sri Dehra Sahib
data.address: Manimajra, Chandigarh, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI DEHRA SAHIB MATA RAJ KAUR, is situated in the Manimajra town in Chandigarh.

MATA RAJ KAUR JI, wife of SHRI RAM RAI JI(SHRI GURU HAR RAI SAHIB JI"s son), got upset with her husband & came from Dehradun to Manimajra & stayed here. RAM RAI JI had changed a verse in Baani in order to please Aurangzeb, where in place of " Mitti Musalmaan Di" was changed to " Mitti Be-Imaan Di". MATA RAJ KAUR JI was a great follower of SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI & Guru Ghar. MATA RAJ KAUR JI was not able to bear the disrespect & left RAM RAI JI and came to Manimajra. After coming to Manimajra, MATA RAJ KAUR JI did lot of worship & people became followers of MATA JI. Once during rainy season, when beam of MATA RAJ KAUR JI"s house started to collapse, MATA JI sent one of her follower to a wealthy person Bhaara Mall & who told Bhaara mall that beam of MATA JI's house is about to collapse & MATA JI has asked to get a pillar put underneath the beam. Bhaara Mall did not pay any attention to this. Then MATA JI sent her follower to Garibu Jatt. Garibu Jatt cut a the trunk of a Ber tree & placed it underneath the beam overnight. MATA JI got pleased with his service & asked him for his wish. Garibu requested with folded hands that his generations to come should not become a subject of the King but they should become Kings. MATA JI gave him a boon that he will become a King & Bhaara Mall will be a tenant under him. With the boon of MATA RAJ KAUR JI, Garibu Jatt became a King & Bhaara Mall a tenant.

This article is written in Bhai Santokh Singh's "Sooraj Prakash" on page number 4715-4718. GURUDWARA SHRI MANJI SAHIB was the residential house of MATA RAJ KAUR JI. MATA JI left for heavenly abode at that place and her cremation was done at this place (Gurudwara Shri Dehra Sahib). Whoever comes to visit MATA JI's interment, all their wishes are fulfilled.

When SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came from battle of Bhangani during Samat 1745 Bikrami 28 Kattak Soodi 15, came to Kapaal Mochan, then GURU JI went by foot from Kapaal Mochan via Rani Raipur, reached MATA RAJ KAUR's place in Manimajra on Maghar Vadi 10 Samat 1745 Bikrami. GURU JI spent some time with MATA JI and told her that whenever she calls for him, He will surely come for her service. GURU JI went from here to his follower Saadak Chaudhary Nihang Khan at village Kotla & reached there on Masseya. This article is available in Martyr Bilaas Bhai Mani Singh poet Seva Singh Kaushal literary production.

Khalsa Ji, MANJI SAHIB GURUDWARA is a Holy place where MATA RAJ KAUR JI & SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI visited & made this Manimajra village a holy place. Whoever comes to this place with devotion, all their wishes are fulfilled.

When SRI GURU TEGBAHADUR SAHIB JI was beheaded in Delhi, Bhai Lakhi Shah Banjara ji cremated GURU SAHIB's body by setting his house at fire in his village. He left delhi and came here with Sangat, prepared Karah Parshad and performed ardas. SRI GURU NANAK DEV JI appeared and asked Bhai Lakhi Shah Ji. He told GURU SAHIB that dont want to live in delhi now. He want to live here. GURU SAHIB asked them to settle down here. And keep serving Baba Sri Chand Ji's place. Bhai Lakhi Shah Ji keep serving this place and later SRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came to this side and met Baba Kandas Ji. GURU SAHIB also sat at Baba Sri Chand Ji's place. GURU SAHIB wrote SRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI with peacock feather. From here GURU SAHIB went towards Naraina (Gurudwara Sri Charan Kamal Sahib, Naraina)

data.name: Gurudwara Baba Zorawar Singh Ji
data.address: Village :- Khizrabad, Distt :- Mohali, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI ZORAWAR SAHIB is situated in Khizrabad, Distt Mohali.

Baba Jorawar Singh Ji was the youngest son of Mata Khivi Ji and Bhai Nathu Ram Lote Tarkhan of Bassi Pathana. His parents brought him in the service of SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI Baba ji continued to play with the sons of GURU SAHIB, Baba ji's face was like Sahibzada Jorawar Singh ji. Mata Sahib Kaur Ji considered Baba Ji as his son and started calling Baba Ji as adopted son. Baba ji was the same age as Sahibzada Ajit Singh ji and he used to learn martial arts with him. Baba ji stayed with GURU SAHIB till the battle of Chamkaur Sahib and got wounded in the battle. He reached the house of Bhai Gursa Singh, a resident of Kotla Nihang Khan in critical condition. Being close to Kotwali, Baba ji did not think it was right to stay here The next night, Bhai Gursa Singh took Baba ji in the chariot to house of his aunt Mai Bhupan in village Dadheri. Bhua ji with good service and medicine weed Baba ji recovered quickly. After some time Baba ji came to Khizrabad Keep doing meditation. at this place. Baba Ji gathered 500 Singhs of this area and reached Talwandi Sabo Ki (Bathinda) in search of GURU SAHIB. But GURU SAHIB went ahead Only 50 Singhs were left with Baba ji, The rest came back GURU SAHIB walked south. Baba Ji met GURU SAHIB at Agra Then he met GURU SAHIB again at Mathura. GURU SAHIB reached at Chittorgarh on Baisakh. Baba ji along with Singhs proceeded to see the fort, but the soldiers stopped them and they clashed with the soldiers. Fighting, Baba Ji was martyred along with other Singh's. GURU SAHIB, cremated Baba Ji and other singhs with his own hands on bank of Gambhiri river. Kotla Nihang Khan and Gurdwara Sahib in Khizrabad are adorned in the memory of Baba ji

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Bangarh Sahib
data.address: Village :- Simbal Majra, Teh :- Nurpur Bedi, Distt :- Ropar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURDWARA SRI BANGARH SAHIB PATSHAHI DASVIN is situated in Village Simbal Majra, Teh Nurpur Bedi, Distt Ropar.

On orders from Aurangzeb, his general Said Khan came here from Delhi to arrest SRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI. On the way he met his sister Naseeran, who advised him to not to arrest GURU SAHIB, but he didn't paid no attention. Then his sister prayed to GURU SAHIB to have mercy on my brother. On other side GURU SAHIB from Sri Anandpur Sahib, shot an arrow, which hit on the Simbal tree. Said khan looked at the arrow, he thought GURU SAHIB must be a magician. The next moment another arrow came and struck the foot of Said Khan's bed. And with it came a letter written on it. That I am not a magician. This is my practice. When Said Khan read this, he began to think that GURU SAHIB is indeed a great being who can read your mind and heart. Then he remembered his sister's prayer. His ego vanished and he longed to see GURU SAHIB. After meeting GURU SAHIB, he became GURU SAHIB's follower.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Satsang Shaib
data.address: Jadhari Gate, Old Ambala City, Distt :- Ambala, Haryana, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI MANJI SAHIB is Situated in the Ambala City. Its Situated in Old Ambala city.

When SHRI GURU TEG BAHADUR SAHIB JI was beheaded in chandani chowk Delhi, no one dared to pick GURU SAHIBS SACRED HEAD and his body. But with wish of Akal purakh, swear storm swept through the city, and under the cover of dark blanket, Bhai Jaita ji managed to escape with GURU SAHIBS SACRED HEAD and Bhai Lakhi Shah cremated GURU SAHIBS Body by setting his house on fire as public funeral would have been dangerous. Bhai Jaita ji stayed here for some time. At this place known as Jaghadri gate used to flow a river named Tangari/Dabgri. Crossing the river, seeing the shade of a bunch of berries, Bhai Jaita Ji removed the basket from his head (in which was the head of Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji) and placed it on a high place. There were huts of laborers around this place In which many potters lived Bhai Jaita Ji asked the people about the house of a Gur Sikh. On inquiry it was found that there are some Hindu houses in Kaithmajri. Bhai Jaita Ji reached Tuakal Shah's place in Kathmajri and stayed at Ramdasia house with GURU SAHIB's Sees. Gurdwara Shri Sheesh Ganj Sahib is now situated on the place.

When SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI set foot here while going to Kurukshetra on the occasion of solar eclipse to preach Sikhism, the potters said that sometimes the roar of a lion is heard in this place. On enquiry of Guru Sahib Dhumiya (Gujar) said that some time ago a man came here after crossing the river. He had a basket on his head. He was resting under these trees. After he left we saw traces of blood dripping under the place where the basket was hanging but did not know what was in the basket. After hearing this talk, Guru Sahib said that this place belongs to Ninth Patshah Ji and secret lions guard here and in that basket was the head of SHRI GURU TEGH BAHADUR SAHIB JI . As per the order of SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI , Singh's built a platform here which was on the west side of Jandi. SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI stayed here for 21 days and kirtan started flowing in the morning and evening so the name of this place became Satsangat. Here the poor potter presented a donkey to Guru Sahib with great devotion. Guru Sahib donated a donkey to the young son of a poor Brahmin at the Kurukshetra Eclipse Festival and alleviated his poverty.

data.address: Village :- Nesta, Distt :- Amritsar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI MITHASAR SAHIB is situated in Village Nesta, Distt Amritsar city.

This village is located on pakistan border and blessed by visit of SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI . There was a Pandit's house at this place. He had two wives, the elder wife was GURU SAHIB's follower and the younger one was an atheist. The two were arguing with each other, Annoyed by this, Pandit separated them and got two wells were installed for water. The water of the well which belonged to the elder wife turned out to be salty and the water of the other well turned out to be sweet. The older woman accepted it as God's will. SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI reached this place from Bhujang's Dera and asked Gadwai to fetch water from this well. Bibi refused to take water because its water is salty. But GURU SAHIB insisted to drink the water of this well and the water of this well became sweet and the salty of the other.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Guru Arjan Dev Ji Sahib
data.address: Village :- Malu Nangal, Distt :- Amritsar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI SAHIB is situated in village Malu Nangal, Distt Amritsar

SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI visited this place while going to GURU KE BAAG along with Raja Hari Sen of Suket Mandi. In those days this village was known as Kho Nangal and belonged to Lile Pathan's. They were very proud of their caste and presumed themselves as the bravest among pathan's. GURU SAHIB asked his Singhs for water. Singhs visited the well nearby and fetched the water. By the time pathans reached here and damaged the pitcher of water with his stick and said disrespecting words for GURU SAHIB. GURU SAHIB asked his singhs to come back and left for further. While going GURU SAHIB said "Jange Lile Aunge gile". After some time Bhai Malu from Jagdev Kalan attacked this village and destroyed the whole village. With GURU SAHIBS blessing he started a new village which was known after his name Malu Nangal.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Chola Sahib
data.address: Village :- Kaleke, Teh :- Baba Bakala, Distt :- Amritsar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURDWARA SHRI CHOLA SAHIB is situated in Village Kaleke, Teh Baba Bakala, Distt Amritsar.

After becoming 9th GURU, SHRI GURU TEGH BAHADUR SAHIB JI went to visit Darbar Sahib. Masands closed the door for GURU SAHIB. On their way back to Baba Bakala, GURU SAHIB reached here in village kaleke visiting Guru Ka Baag and Valla etc, the Sikhs who reached here with GURU SAHIB saw a surprising thing in the wheat fields. GURU SAHIB went to the field with the Sikhs, While guarding the field, a child was feeding the birds instead of blowing them up. The Sikhs asked the child why he was not flying birds, to which the child replied that just as we are hungry and thirsty, so must they be. GURU SAHIB asked the child where did you learn this and the child said that a saint used to take a bath and utter these wordings "Sabna Jia ka ik data, So main visar na jai". GURU SAHIB asked what is your name. The child told me his name is Naru. GURU SAHIB took Naru with him along. When GURU SAHIB went to the shrines, Naru was present in the service of GURU SAHIB. When GURU SAHIB went to Delhi to give his head, Naru was along with. Arriving in Delhi, GURU SAHIB ordered Naru to attend the service of SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI . Following the orders of GURU SAHIB, Naru came to Sri Anandpur Sahib from Delhi and attended the service of SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI . SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI made Naru Nar Singh by giving him nectar Nar Singh was injured while leaving the fort of Sri Anandpur Sahib with GURU SAHIB. A Khatri Sikh from Ghanoli served Nar Singh until he was healed. After recovering, Nar Singh went to Damdama Sahib, Talwandi Sahib and placed his head at the feet of GURU SAHIB. At that time GURU SAHIB was taking a bath in the morning. GURU SAHIB got pleased by Nar Singh's gesture and gave the following blessings.

  • A Chola Sahib which GURU SAHIB used to wear

  • A Hukamnama Sahib Signed by SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI with Bow

  • A hand painting of SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI and Bhai Nar Singh Ji

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Bhai Shalo Ji Sahib
data.address: Village :- Pandori Waraich, Bye Pass Road, Amritsar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURDWARA BHAI SHALO JI SAHIB is situated in the Village Pandori Warraich, Amritsar. Now a days it is situated in Holy City, Amritsar. Bhai Shalo Ji was born on 29th September 1554 in Dhaula Kangra village, in Malwa region. His father was Bhai Dyala Ji and mother was Mata Sukhdei Ji. His parents were followers of Hazrat Sakhi Sarvar and turned into gursikh, after meeting SRI GURU RAM DASS JI. Bhai Sahib's parents went to Majitha and Bhai sahib stayed with GURU SAHIB and started selfless service (sewa) and meditation (simran).


Establishment of City:- For Establishment of city, Bhai Salho ji brought traders and workers of 52 Castes and settled here. Guru Arjun dev Ji delighted to know this and gave charge of whole city to Bhai sahib.


Renovation of Sarovar::-For strengthening and renovating of the Sarovar, The fuel required for klin was finished. Bhai sahib came here to village Pandori Warraich etc and exclaimed that a person who would donate fuel (Biofuel like dung cakes, Firewood, agri-residue etc) would be blessed with a son. Many people gave donations and bhai sahib bought carts full of fuel. When GURU SAHIB knew this, he was very much pleased with bhai sahib and stated the person who would bath, with heart and soul, in Bhai Shalo's pond would be blessed with son and weak children who bath in it would become healthy.

When GURU SAHIB came here, no body served, When GURU SAHIB was about to leave he asked someone whats the name of this village. He told that name of this village is Kartarpur. Then GURU SAHIB said this is not Kartarpur, This is Jhootha Kartarpur.</p>

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Patshahi Chevin Sahib
data.address: Village :- Butala, Teh :- Baba Bakala, Distt :- Amritsar, Punjab, India
data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><b>GURUDWARA SHRI PATSHAHI CHEVIN SAHIB</b> is situated in Village Butala, Teh Baba Bakala, Distt Amritsar. Earlier these villages were follower of Sakhi Sarwar. Bhai Palha ji lived with his mother Santi ji. They were followers of Sikh GURU's. When Bibi Santi ji got married in this village, she refused to accept Sakhi Sarwar. Due to which the villagers and the family strongly opposed her and expelled her from the community. Mata Santi Ji and her husband used to live in poverty with great difficulty, but did not give up Seva Simran. Shortly after the birth of Bhai Palha ji, his father passed away, Mata ji raised Palha ji by doing labor Jobs and preached Gurmat from his childhood. When Baba Ji was young, he expressed his desire to see GURU SAHIB. Mata ji said read Gur Bani and remember them. When ever GURU SAHIB comes, offer him a quarter of a rupee and a lump of jaggery and bow down. Seeing the devotion of Bhai Palha Ji, <strong>SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI</strong> came to Butala Nagar and met Bhai Palha ji who was working in his fields. Mother was also delighted to see GURU SAHIB. GURU SAHIB expressed his desire to eat langar. The jealous people of the village have come together to watch the spectacle. They knew that Palha is so poor lets see how he will server GURU SAHIB and Sikhs. Trusting in Guru sahib, Mata Ji started baking whatever flour was in the house. With the grace of GURU SAHIB, the langar continued. GURU SAHIB first asked all the people of the village to eat langar and then he and the Sikhs ate langar. Seeing this miracle, the pride of the people was shattered and the whole town became a Sikh of GURU SAHIB. Satisfied with the service of Mata Ji and Bhai Palha Ji, GURU SAHIB promised to be patient with one another and to keep the langar bhandara full. Mata ji said who will marry with poor Palha. Then a Gur Sikh from the Sangat agreed to get his daughter married to Bhai Palha ji. Bhai Palha ji's descendants still serve GURU SAHIB's places in this village. </p>

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Tahla Sahib
data.address: Amritsar Taran Taaran Road, Village :- Guruwali, Distt :- Amritsar, Punjab, India
data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><strong>GURUDWARA SHRI TAHLA SAHIB</strong> is situated in Village Guruwali, Distt Amritsar. Its is situated on Amritsar Taran Taaran Road marks a historic place, where <strong>BABA DEEP SINGH JI SHAHEED</strong> fought a  battle with Mughals. Ahmad Shah Durani's general Jahan Khan captured and demolished SHRI HARIMANDIR SAHIB and filled sacred pool with slaughtered animals. <strong>BABA DEEP SINGH JI SHAHEED</strong> was at Takhat Shri Damdama Sahib, Talwandi Sabo and was of approx. 75 years old in those days. To take revenge and recapture and rebuild SHRI HARIMANDIR SAHIB, Baba ji started for Amritsar along with 500 Sikhs. Before leaving he took pledge that "I will take rest only after liberating SHRI DARBAR SAHIB ". Many more Sikhs joined him on the way. Mughals army under command of Jahan Khan clashed with Sikh army here. After a long and fierce battle at this place, both warriors were beheaded in a common attack on each other. But, when BABA JI fell down on the ground, one of the young soldiers reminded him of his pledge. BABA JI immediately got up and took his head on his left hand and started fighting by taking Khanda (a double-edged sword weighing 18 seers/15 Kg) in his right hand. On seeing this miracle, the enemy started fleeing and but BABA JI along with his soldiers continued the fight and reached Amritsar, liberated SHRI HARIMANDIR SAHIB, And took his last breath by placing his head in the southern part of the parikrama of SHRI HARMANDIR SAHIB, now known as Bunga Baba Deep Singh. At the place, where BABA JI was beheaded, there was a very big Seasham tree(Tahli) with a bigger girth due which is known as TAHLA SAHIB. it is nearly 7 km from Amritsar on Tarn Taran Road.</p>

GURDWARA SRI DAMDAMA SAHIB is situated in Village Aulakh Bhindi, Distt Amritsar.

In 1672 SRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI went to Srinagar and blessed Mata Bhag Bhari Ji accepted Khadar Chola from her. Then he blessed Sai Kaul Shah Ji and appointed Sodhi Shah Ji to spread sikhism in kashmir area. From Kashmir GURU SAHIB reached Nankana Sahib and preached Local Sangat. From Nankana Sahib GURU SAHIB reached here via Mandri and Bhai Matewa. When GURU SAHIB was staying here Bhai Daya Ram Marwaha Khatri of mandiali village sent invitation for marraige (Sahi Chithi *). Marraige was fixed 6 Saun Sunday. Baraat started from Matewa and landed at Mandiali village. With GURU SAHIB there were 10 singhs, 1. Bhai Bhana Ji (son of Baba Budha Ji) 2. Bhai Bidhi Chand Ji, 3. Bhai Jetha Ji. 4.Bhai Bhagta Ji, 5 Bhai Behlo Ji 6. Bhai Tirloka Ji, 7. Bhai Taru Ji, 8. Bhai Tota Ji, 9. Bhai Purana Ji, 10. Bhai Sain Das Ji. Bhai Bidhi Chand Ji marraige rituals. After the marriage, GURU SAHIB crossed the Ravi River on Wednesday, August 7 and reached this place. GURU SAHIB gave many blessings to this place. Returned to Amritsar via veroke.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Dulamsar Sahib
data.address: Village :- Mauran, Distt :- Barnala, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI DULAMSAR SAHIB, is situated in Village Mauran, Distt Barnala.

SHRI GURU TEGBAHADUR SAHIB JI while living at Dhilwan used to come here and preach local people. GURU SAHIB used to come here at Dulmi Di Dhab. The mounds of Dulmi had been deserted and piled up long before the village of GURU SAHIB came here. In those days Maur Mana was in the south of Dulmi Dhab. The name of Dhilwan's maur was driven by a Jatt of Mann Got (Surname) named Dallo. At this place there used to be a ditch and a well in the herd of curry which is still present. Related to this place is the story of a Jatt named Dallo who was a resident of Moran. He used to keep cows in this place. During the time when GURU SAHIB was staying at dhilwan, he used to bring milk of cows in GURU SAHIb's service, being happy, GURU SAHIB gave a turban to Dallo. When he came home with the turban, his wife gave the turban to Marasi of the village. The next day when he came with milk, he did not have the turban given to him. GURU SAHIB asked Dallo where is your turban then Dallo told the truth. GURU SAHIB said, "Bhai, we have given you GURU NANAK DEV JI's Sidhant Satnaam Waheguru Gurmantra to strengthen you, so that you can become the leader of the team, but you are the slave of your wife." We wanted to make you a team leader.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Kabutar Sahib
data.address: Nohar City, Distt :- Hanumangarh, Rajasthan, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI KABUTAR SAHIB is situated in Teh Town Nohar, Distt Hanumangarh, Rajasthan.

After leaving Talwandi Sabo, SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came here while going to Nanded (Hazoor Sahib). GURU SAHIB came here via Sirsa. GURU SAHIB CAMPED near water reservoir. GURUDWARA SHRI SHEEN TALAI SAHIB is situated over there. Here people from Jain community used to feed pigeons. When GURU SAHIB came here, A pigeon got came under the hoof of Guru Sahib's horse and died. Local people objected this is opposed GURU SAHIB. GURU SAHIB said you people are crying for one, If all the pigeons die, then what. And suddenly all the pigeons died. Local People understood the thing that he is not a normal man. Then people begged that if you can kill them then you can make them alive also. Accepting the repeated requests of the Sangat, GURU SAHIB said, "Bring their feed." When the sangat got the feed, GURU SAHIB said get up, take off your feed. As soon as he said this, all the pigeons got up and started biting the bait. All the pigeons were alive except the first one which was killed by GURU SAHIB's horses hoof. The sangat again requested to make it alive. Then GURU SAHIB said we have come here to release him from life. so it cannot be alive. After this Guru Sahib went to Suhava Sahib.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Sukha Singh Mehtab Singh
data.address: Hanumangarh City, Distt :- Hanumangarh, Rajasthan, India
data.description:
GURDWARA SRI SUKHA SINGH MEHTAB SINGH is situated in Distt town, Hanumangarh, Rajasthan.

After leaving Talwandi Sabo, Zakariya Khan Bahadur of Lahore district had started targeting the Sikhs, forcing the Khalea to flee from the Punjab to either the hills or the desert. Massa Rangar was tasked with preventing Sikh pilgrims from approaching Amritsar. Massa Rangar took possession of Sri Darbar Sahib, started drinking meat and alcohol, and made prostitute dance in the Darbar Sahib, On the other hand, Baba Budha Singh Ji, the chief of the Budha Dal Misl, was staying at this place, at village Dhab Wala. As the name implies, this place was a reservoir of water in the center of the desert and a mound of about 2000 Acres. Bhai Bakala Ji from Amritsar reached here and told all the news about Sri Darbar Sahib to Baba Baba Budha Singh Ji. Baba Budha Singh challenged his Sikhs to go to Amritsar and take revenge. Accepting this challenge, Bhai Sukha Singh Ji and Bhai Mehtab Singh Ji started their journey towards Amritsar. When they reached Amritsar, got themselves dressed like muslims and arrived at the Golden Temple and said that he had come there to pay the revenue. Massa Rangar was drinking alcohol in Sri Darbar Sahib and watching the prostitute dance. They beheaded Massa Rangar, hanging his head on a spear they fled Sri Darbar Sahib. Taking his head, they left for Rajasthan, On the way they stopped here in Hanumangarh for the night. Here they rested under tree, which is still preserved here. In the morning they played khudo khundi (hockey) with Massa Rangar's head. The next morning they reached Dabla and hung his head on a juniper tree.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Kailon Sahib Patshahi Nauvin

GURUDWARA SHRI KAILON SAHIB PATSHAHI NAUVIN, is situated in Outskirts of village Dhilwan, Distt Barnala.

SHRI GURU TEGBAHADUR SAHIB JI came here while on malwa tour. GURU SAHIB came here via Mulowal, Sekha, Katu, Handyaya, Arisar and Sohiana Sahib. In those days there was village here. But no one from the village served GURU SAHIB. From here GURU SAHIB went to the place where Gurudwara Shri Patshahi Nauvin Sahib, dhilwan is situated. When people from the village came to know about this thing, they regretted their mistake. When GURU SAHIB started from here, he said that these people are very arrogant and will go from here and settle in village to village, And this village will be deserted. GURU SAHIB's words came true and the village was devastated. Nowadays, it is famous for its piles of kaile It is said that some of the locals settled at Rampura Phul near village Kolonke.

data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI NANAK TILLA SAHIB is situated in Village Sahawa, Distt Churu Rajasthan.

Village Sahawa is situated on Nohar - Taranagar Road. This place is blessed with touch of SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI. GURU SAHIB came here while on his second udhasi. GURU SAHIB rested here 6-7 km on outer of village Sahwa. At place where Gurdwara Shri Sahwa Sahib (in the village) is situated, there used to live Sidhs. Bhai Lakhi Shah, A animal trader was wondering here and there in search of water for his animals. When he asked sidhs fo water, they in sent him to GURU SAHIB to test GURU SAHIB. When Bhai Lakhi Shah requested GURU SAHIB for water, GURU SAHIB went to village and dug a small hole and put water from his garvi, Bhai Lakhi Shah asked Guru Sahib would that be enough water for all his animals ?. GURU SAHIB asked him to let his animal drink. And Lakhi Shah was surprised that all his animal had drank water and it was still the same in quantity. Seeing this Bhai Lakhi Shah fell on the feets of GURU SAHIB and became GURU's Sikh.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Patshahi Nauvin Sahib
data.address: Village :- Pandher, Distt :- Barnala. Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI PATSHAHI NAUVIN SAHIB, is situated in village Pander, Distt Barnala.

History according to History Board in Gurdwara Sahib :- SHRI GURU TEGBAHADUR SAHIB JI came here while on malwa tour. GURU SAHIB came here from Village Dhilwan. Along with GURU SAHIB, the Singhs told the people sitting in the village that the SHRI GURU TEGH BAHADUR JI has come to their town. And they have to spend the night. The people of the village told GURU SAHIB about this place and GURU SAHIB set foot here. Then GURU SAHIB told the Sikhs to go ahead and spend the night. The wishes of those who attend with devotion will be fulfilled. From here GURU SAHIB went to Alisher.

History according to Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha :- SHRI GURU TEGH BAHADUR SAHIB came here from village Mour. He did not camp as the villagers were disrespectful. Where the horse stayed for some time, there is Gurdwara Sahib built now. From this place GURU SAHIB went to Alisher.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Patshahi Chevin Sahib
data.address: Village :- Kharak Singh wala, Distt :- Barnala, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURDWARA SRI PATSHAHI CHEVIN SAHIB, is situated in Village Kharak Singhwala, Distt Barnala.

SRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI came here from village Takhtupura Sahib during his journey to Malwa. Coming to this place, GURU SAHIB rested. The sangat served GURU SAHIB with milk and langar Pleased, GURU SAHIB blessed with son and food. At this place the sangat of village Yusufpura came and requested GURU SAHIB to visit their village also. GURU SAHIB said, "we don't have time yet, we will come again." The sangat discussed among themselves how to take him. Then a man from the sangat said if the sangat gives permission then I can take GURU SAHIB. After the permission of the sangat, the man stole GURU SAHIB's gold stirrups and saddle and took it to Yusufpura. When the next morning GURU SAHIB got ready to leave, the Sikhs searched for saddles and stirrups, but could not find them. Then GURU SAHIB said that the sangat of Yusufpura came yesterday, one of them stole the saddle and stirrups. And now get ready to go to Yusufpura. On the arrival of GURU SAHIB the sangat os yusufpura, gathered and GURU SAHIB said you have stolen our saddle and stirrup, Then the sangat said, we did not steal, we have brought it our village to force you to come here. GURU SAHIB said happily, "You are the ones who brought us." From that day the name of that village became Himmatpura The sangat rendered great service to GURU SAHIB. Even after searching a lot, if not found, then GURU SAHIB simply said, "some crazy must have taken". Even now Someone goes mentally upset from family of the man who stole the stirrups.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Jhotasar Sahib
data.address: Village :- Bangher, Teh :- Talwandi Sabo, Distt :- Bathinda, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI GUNGSAR SAHIB is situated in Village Bangher Distt Bathinda.

On request of local Sangat SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI accompanied them to Qilla. GURU SAHIB reached there and asked people that if they have any problem in life. People requested GURU SAHIB that there's a monster ( Deo ) who destroys there's houses and disturbs them. Kindly get them free from from monster. GURU SAHIB called upon monster and asked him that why was he disturbing people. He bowed in front of GURU SAHIB and told that he was hungry from long time. Kindly do some thing for him, he will leave the fort for ever. GURU SAHIB sat for some time and found that there was Bull common of ten villages. People were also disturbed from that Bull. GURU SAHIB send some Singhs to get that Bullock. When Singhs reached here in this village they asked people about that bull. People laughingly told that bull was sitting in water. Bhai Mailagar Singh went to him and asked " Chalo Bhai GURU SAHIB ne Bulayaa hai" and showed him GURU SAHIB's Hukamnama. Bull came out and Singhs started following him towards Bathinda. Bull reached Fort in front of GURU SAHIB. GURU SAHIB asked Bhai Mailagar Singh to cut Bull's head in one attempt of sword. Bhai Sahib did the same way. And it was offered to monster and his hunger was fulfilled. GURU SAHIB sent monster to sirhind and told him that his services will be needed there. GURU SAHIB asked Singhs that if villager served them or not. Singhs told that they didnt served anything infact they teased them. GURU SAHIB said that this village will not grow anymore. Who so ever will leave this village will excelrate. When people of this village came to know about this, they met GURU SAHIB at talwandi sabo. Along with them they brought weapons and food and offered GURU SAHIB and asked to forgive them. GURU SAHIB said that battels are over now so he doesn't need any weapons. Food they can put into langar. GURU SAHIB told people that at place of Dhab in village a lot of Sadhus had meditated. So it is a very pious place. Serve the travelers follow the sikhism and also not to consume tabacoo.

GURUDWARA SHRI BAGSAR SAHIB is situated in Village Jassi Bagwali Distt Bathinda.

This village is situated on Bathinda Dabwali Road. SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came here after battle of Mukatsar via Gidarbaha, Jangirana and Kot Guru. GURU SAHIB reached here on his blue horse and GURU SAHIB entered the pool with the horse. All the clothes which were soaked and the horses which were soaked became white. The sangat was very surprised to see this. There lived a sadhu Ramanand who also came and fell at the feet of GURU SAHIB. According to GURU SAHIB, SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI also visited this place. GURU SAHIB stayed here for ten days. And blessed this place that the devotee who will take bath and sangat here, his mind will be purified and liberated.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Patshahi Dasvin Sahib
data.address: Village :- Kotguru, Distt :- Bathinda, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI PATSHAHI DASVIN SAHIB is situated in Village Kotguru, Distt Bathinda.

WhenSHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI reached village Bajak from Shri Mukatsar Sahib. A sadhu from Divana sect tried to meet GURU SAHIB at different locations, But couldn't. Finally When GURU SAHIB was resting at Village Maluka, He came there and argued with Singhs guarding GURU SAHIB, In the argument, he got wounded. When GURU SAHIB came to know about this, he took his head in his lap and asked his wish, He said he had only on wish to have your glimpse, Now as he had that he just want to leave this world. When people from Divana sect came to know about his death, they wanted to take revenge. Sukhu and Budhu, two sadhus of same Divana sect from nearby Ghuda village, came for this. But as soon as they came in front of GURU SAHIB, anger was gone out of their hearts. They sang local song for GURU SAHIB. Further they requested GURU SAHIB that they want to carry GURU SAHIB like Bhai Gani Khan and Bhai Nabi Khan carried GURU SAHIB on bed. Accepting their request GURU SAHIB dressed in blue, threw his hair back and sat on the bed Sukhu and Budhu were very happy and they along with other two other Singhs carried the bed on their shoulders and brought it here on the outer of village KotGuru. Sukhu ran and started circling GURU SAHIB's bed and later fell in front of GURU SAHIB. GURU SAHIB told the Sikhs to bathe Sukhu. When Sukhu regained consciousness after bathing, he objected, why did you bathe me, The affection that was in my mind, with the bath, it remained a little. GURU SAHIB was pleased with Sukhu and gave him a four-cornered rupee and said that worshiping him would double the affection. GURU SAHIB gave this gift to Sukhu and Budhu and moved on.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Gurusar Sahib
data.address: Village :- Gurusar, Distt :- Bathinda, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI PATSHAHI DASVIN SAHIB is situated in Village Gurusar, Distt Bathinda.

SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came here from from dina. Along with GURU SAHIB were some Singhs. When GURU SAHIB asked, people said that his name is Rukhwala GURU SAHIB said don't call it Rukhwala from now on, its name is Rakhwala GURU SAHIB camped outside the village. The villagers collected hay for the horses and supplies for the Singhs. It was here that the Panch's of Jalal village offered two horses milk and some gur(Jaggery) in the service of GURU SAHIB. they also lovingly presented a beautiful and sharp spear to GURU SAHIB, which GURU SAHIB was very happy to accept. Villagers of the Jalals, told that people from nearby village hates them and sometimes comes to fight. Please promise us victory. GURU SAHIB said as long as you continue to obey the GURU's house, victory will be yours. The people of Jalal were very happy to hear this gift. The words of GURU SAHIB came true Whenever someone came attacking on them, they always won. After some time, a group of Singh's came to Jalal village. The people of Jalal village stole five horses at night and also killed two Singh's. When Singhs came to know about this in the morning, the group got together and looted the village and scolded the villagers. The people then memorized the words of GURU SAHIB and prepared Karah Prasad and apologized to Singhs and promised to stay in the shelter of Khalsa from now on. Singhs was happy and settled the villagers, where GURU SAHIB had camped and named the village Gurusar. In the processions of Darbar Sahib, the tree of Jand with which GURU SAHIB had tied his horse.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Bhagat Namdev Ji Sahib
data.address: Village :- Ghuman, Distt :- Gurdaspur, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI BHAGAT NAMDEV JI SAHIB, GHUMAN


Bhagat Namdev Ji was born to Mata Goni Bai and Father Dama Seth in 1270. Bhagat Namdev ji spent his child hood in the village Narsi Namdev. Bhagat Ji was from Chhimba caste which is treated as lower caste in india by Pandits / Brahmins. Bhagat Ji was follower of Lord Vitthal (Krishna). His father used to offer parshad daily to GOD. One day he had to go to a distant village in the midst of business. That duty was given to Bhagat Namdev Ji. Bal Namdev ji and went to Kesari Raj ji's temple and performed Puja with great devotion and placed the plate in front of idol. But there was no movement in the statue of Lord. It seemed to Namdev ji that there was a great disaster, Bhagwan ji takes parshad every day and it is was not happening today. Bhagat ji offered many prayers to GOD, but still God did not ate parshad. Bhagat ji warned that if you do not take parshad from my hand and milk from the bowl, then I will give up my life here. Seeing Bhagat ji's devotion, GOD took a material form and drank milk.

Bhagat Ji's Guru Visoba Khechar lived at Aundha Nagnath Temple, who introduced Bhagat Ji to Nirgun Prameshar. Once Namdev jI went to Aundha Nagnath Temple. The Hindu priests of that temple believed in the caste system, after reaching the temple, Namdev Ji sat and started worshipping the GOD, but the Hindu priests grabbed his arm dragged him out of the temple. The priests said that Namdev Ji could not worship in the temple because he was from a lower caste. Namdev Ji was deeply hurt so he went to the back of the temple and started worshipping GOD. In his prayer he said:

"Joyfully, I came to Your Temple, O Lord. While Namdev Ji was worshipping, he was driven out. I am of a lower caste, O Lord; why was I born in the family of fabric dyers? I picked up my blanket and went back, to sit behind the temple" Namdev also said: "O Lord, please do not forget me because if You forget me then where should I go. There is nowhere else to go and no one else to believe in except You." He further prayed: "Please do not forget me, do not forget me, please do not forget me, O Lord. The temple priests have doubts about this, and everyone is furious with me. Calling me low-caste and untouchable, they beat me and dragged me out, what should I do now ? If You give me salvation after I am dead, no one will know that I attained salvation. These Priests, these religious scholars, call me low-born, when they say this, they tarnish Your honor as well. You are called kind and compassionate, the power of Your Arm is absolutely unrivalled".

As Namdev uttered the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the temple turned around to face the Lord's humble devotee. The Lord turned the temple around to west to face Namdev and its back to the priests. That temple is still rotated as can be seen at the site. In most Hindu temples, the water pool is normally located at the front of the mandir, at this site, it can be seen at the back of the temple. Further, most temples face east since that is the most auspicious direction in the Hindu faith as the Sun rises from the East and the Sun is considered the destroyer of darkness and the giver of life. According to the teachings of Sant Visoba Khechar, Bhagat Naam Dev ji traveled all over India with Sant Dyaneshwar. After Sant Dyaneshwar left this world, Bhagatji came to Punjab and camped here at Ghuman village of Gurdaspur district. He meditated here for 18 years. Many verses of Bhagat Ji are recorded in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Jani Shah Ji Sahib
data.address: Sri Hargobindpur, Distt :- Gurdaspur, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI JANI SHAH JI SAHIB

Syed Jani Shah Ji, a Muslim had left his family in search of God. He was wandering day and night, he worshiped the incarnations of Hindus and Muslims, prayed five prayers and kept fast but found nothing. Someone told him about SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI. After hearing about their glory, he was very happy. SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI was sitting on SHRI GURU NANAK DEV JI's throne. And in those days GURU SAHIB was camping here at Sri Hargobindpur. So Jani Shah ji came here and met Khawaja Roshan ji (the horse attendant of SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI). Jani Shah ji told Khwaja ji about his condition. After listening, Khwaja ji glorified SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI and said that you should stay here and meditate.

Hearing this, Jani Shah ji also sat here and suffered hunger, thirst, day and night in the shade of the sun. After some time, GURU SAHIB sent his Sikhs to Jani Shah ji to give him wealth, garments or anything else he want. But Jani Shah ji abandoned all these things and said "Jani ko jani Mila do" GURU SAHIB got a wall constructed a high wall to test him. But Jani Shah ji remained sitting in his devotion. When the Sikhs requested again, GURU SAHIB said that if Jani wants to meet Jani, then he should jump into the river Beas. The Sikhs conveyed GURU SAHIB's message to Jani Shah ji. Hearing these words Jani Shah ji ran towards the river beas.

GURU SAHIB sent Bhai Bidhi ji to bring Jani Shah ji back. Jani Shah ji came and bowed at GURU SAHIB's feet. GURU SAHIB hugged Syed Jani Shah ji and blessed him with Jani (God) and also blessed whoever comes to your court with devotion, his wishes will be fulfilled.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Tapiana Sahib

data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI TAPIANA SAHIB, GHUMAN

Bhagat Namdev Ji was born to Mata Goni Bai and Father Dama Seth in 1270. Bhagat Namdev ji spent his child hood in the village Narsi Namdev, Maharasthtra. Preaching the truth of life Bhagat Ji reached village Ghumaan, Distt Gurdaspur via Gwalior, Mathura, Banaras, delhi etc. Bhagat Ji meditated in the village Ghuman and nearby area for 18 years. One day Bhagat ji was in meditation when pandit keshodas was suffering from leprosy came here. There was blood flowing from his body, and he was so much in pain that he was thinking of suicide. When pandit told Bhagat Ji about his problem, Bhagat asked him to take a dip in water pond near by. By doing so keshodas was fully cured. After this Pandit fell on Bhagat Ji's feet. That water pond is srovar now.

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Granthian Sahib
data.address: Sri Hargobindpur, Distt :- Gurdaspur, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI GRANTHIA SAHIB, Sri Hargobindpur

This city is blessed with sacred visit of SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI and SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI. In 1687 during monsoon days, SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI crossing beas camped here while coming from kartapur sahib. Earlier this place was inhabited by SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI in 1644, but later it was occupied by Chandu Shah and Bhagwan Das Khatri. When SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB camped here Bhagwan Das opposed GURU SAHIB and spoke bad words. Due to which the Sikhs taking permission from GURU SAHIB, thrashed him and threw in the river. After hearing the news of his father, Gherd's son Ratan Chand and Chandu's son Karam Chand complained to Sube Abdul Khan of Jalandhar. Accepting their request, Abdul Khan attacked GURU SAHIB with an army of 15,000. There was a terrible war in this area for three days, In which Abdul Khan and his son Nabi Bakhsh and five generals were killed. GURU SAHIB came here, opened his waist and took rest at place where Gurdwara Sri Damdama Sahib is situated. Bhai Jattu ji Bhai Mathra ji Bhai Nano ji Bhai Shaktu ji, Sikhs of GURU SAHIB were martyred in this war. GURU SAHIB himself performed the last rites of martyred Sikhs, and also buried the Turks by digging a pit and built a beautiful platform on it.

This city is blessed with sacred visit of SRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI and SRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI. In 1687 during monsoon days, SRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI crossing beas camped here while coming from kartapur sahib. Earlier this place was inhabited by SRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI in 1644, but later it was occupied by Chandu Shah and Bhagwan Das Khatri.

When SRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB camped at place where Gurdwara Shri Granthian Sahib is situated, Bhagwan Das opposed GURU SAHIB and spoke bad words. Due to which the Sikhs taking permission from GURU SAHIB, thrashed him and threw in the river. After hearing the news of his father, Gherd's son Ratan Chand and Chandu's son Karam Chand complained to Sube Abdul Khan of Jalandhar. Accepting their request, Abdul Khan attacked GURU SAHIB with an army of 15,000. There was a terrible war in this area for three days, In which Abdul Khan and his son Nabi Bakhsh and five generals were killed. GURU SAHIB came at place where Gurdwara Shri Damdama Sahib is situated, opened his waist and took rest. Since then the name of that place came to be Damdama Sahib. Bhai Jattu ji Bhai Mathra ji Bhai Nano ji Bhai Shaktu ji, Sikhs of GURU SAHIB were martyred in this war. GURU SAHIB himself performed the last rites of martyred Sikhs, and also buried the Turks by digging a pit and built a beautiful platform on it.

It was here that GURU SAHIB gave a sermon to Jani Shah Ji and he also received Sikhi Dharan. It is from here that GURU SAHIB sent Bhai Garia ji and other Sikhs for preaching. GURU SAHIB built a beautiful city here. In the city, got Maseet built for muslim sangat along with 40 wells. As GURU SAHIB got it built since then this place was know as GURU KI MASEET. Baba Budha Ji and Bhai Gurdas Ji came here to see GURU SAHIB. After GURU SAHIB's name this city was named Hargobindpur It is from here that Baba Budha ji went to Ramdas in his last days.

GURUDWARA SHRI SHAHEEDGANJ SAHIB is situated in village Nanowal, Teh Garshankar Distt Hoshairpur.

The tree was dried up but grew up again after GURU SAHIB's touch.

Sahibzaada Ajit Singh Ji came here while coming back from Bassi Kalan. In that battle many Sikhs got injured, Some were cremated at Gurdwara Sri Harian Velan Sahib, Some at Gurdwara Shaheedan Sahib Ladhewal. And two Sikhs expired here. Those were cremated here by Sahibzada Ajit Singh Ji.

data.address: Village :- Theri, Distt :- Mukatsar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURDWARA SRI THERI SAHIB

This village is situated in Distt Mukatsar Sahib. SRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came here from village Gurusar Sahib. A Jogi named Hukum Nath lived here, who performed many miracles. When GURU SAHIB came here, Hukum Nath Jogi wanted to show his miracles, but GURU SAHIB took away all the miracles with the tip of his arrow, because of which Hukum Nath was very ashamed and left here overnight with his belongings.

Grave of Kasam Bhatti:- GURU SAHIB saluted the grave of Muslim here with an arrow. Singhs asked GURU SAHIB the reason for this. GURU SAHIB said that this was Singh's exam In which they succeeded and GURU SAHIB got a punishment of Rs 25, With this money Karah Parshad was prepared and served in the congregation.

Jand Sahib :- When GURU SAHIB came here, there were three small Jand trees from one mudh. GURU SAHIB hung his kamaraksa and weapons on these jand trees. Seeing that the jands were bent, the Singhs requested that these jand would not be able to bear the weight, and may break. GURU SAHIB blessed these , it will remain forever and thousands of beings will be blessed with its darshan. Those three Jand are now present in the form of full fledge tree

data.name: Gurudwara Shri Ghat Sahib
data.address: Nangal Township, Nangal City, Distt :- Ropar, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURDWARA SRI GHAT SAHIB

This Gurudwara Sahibs is situated in the Nangal Township, Nangal City in Ropar Distt. When SRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came, here used to be a satluj river bank. When the local boatman / Boat operators came to know about GURU SAHIB visiting the river bank to cross the river they all were very excited. They all decorated their boats as they wanted GURU SAHIB to sit in their boat. There was one another boatman named Saida, who was very poor and couldn't decorate his boat. All decorated boats were lined up but Saida's boat was at last. When GURU SAHIB reached here, He went to every boat and asked whos boat is this ?, Every owner came and told that this was his boat. When GURU SAHIB reached last boat and asked whos boat is this, Saida humbly replied GURU SAHIB it is yours's. GURU SAHIB got impressed with his reply. And sat in his boat. When GURU SAHIB reached on other side he offered gold coins to Bhai Saida. But he refused and said. GURU SAHIB you and me are doing same job. I am helping people to cross the river and and you are helping people cross this river of life. Kindly help me in crossing that. GURU SAHIB blessed him that not only you but your 21 generations will be free from cycle of live and death.

Bibi Bhani Ji was daughter of SHRI GURU AMAR DAS JI, wife of SHRI GURU RAMDAS JI mother of SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI, grand mother of SHRI GURU HARGOBIND SAHIB JI, great grand mother of SHRI GURU TEGBAHADUR SAHIB JI and Great great Grand Mother of SHRI GURU HARRAI SAHIB JI and SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI. Great great great Grand Mother of SHRI GURU HARKARISHAN SAHIB JI After setting up this city SHRI GURU ARJAN DEV JI opened a Leprosy Ashram here for the treatment of lepers. data.name: Gurudwara Shri Lakeer Sahib
data.address: Taran Taaran City, Distt :- Taran Taaran, Punjab, India
data.description:
GURUDWARA SHRI LAKEER SAHIB, TARAN TAARAN

This place is located in the city of Tarn Taran. In those days, this place was in the village of Fateh Chak. Gurdwara Shri Darbar Sahib is located at a distance of one kilometer from here. In 1757 AD, when Ahmed Shah Abdali's forces desecrated Sri Harmandir Sahib, Baba Deep Singh Ji performed a prayer at Damdama Sahib (Talwandi Sabo) and started towards Sri Amritsar Sahib to take revenge for this and to liberate Darbar Sahib. Baba Deep Singh Ji was 75 years old in those days. Reaching at this place (village of Fateh Chak ), around 5000 Khalsa forces gathered with them. Ahead, the Mughal army was in large numbers Baba Deep Singh ji knew that there would be martyrdom in this war Knowing this, Baba ji called the Khalsa army and drew a line at this place with his 18 Kilo sword (Double Edged Sword) and said that only those warriors who love Harmandar more than their own lives should come forward. All the Khalsa warriors crossed the line with enthusiasm and energy. Going forward, a fierce battle took place between the two armies at Tahla Sahib. From that place, Baba ji reached Harmandar Sahib while carrying his head on hand and gave martyrdom and freed the Darbar Sahib.

data.description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><B>GURUDWARA SHRI DASHMESHGARH SAHIB PATSHAHI DASVIN</B> is situated in Village Bhalan, Teh Nurpur Bedi, Distt Ropar. <BR /><BR /><b>SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI</b> fought fourteen battles in his life time for humanity. Here GURU SAHIB fought fifth battle against hill rulers. When rulers were unhappy with increasing fame of SHRI ANANDPUR SAHIB, They under leadership of Raja Amer Chand of Fort Kehloor met Dilawar Khan of Lahore. They informed him that GURU SAHIB had started building army and collecting weapons. This would be a danger in coming days for Mughal Empire. Dilawar Khan sent his Son with army of two thousand soldiers. But he couldn't cross Sutlej river and after attacking and looting barwa nagar camped at Bhallan. In those days here used to be a small fort, Sutlej was on east side of that fort and in North and South were deep .... There was only one entrance from west side. GURU SAHIB's army chased away Mughal army from this area. Next year again Dilawar Khan sent his general Husain Khan and son Nazim Khan with much bigger army in numbers. They attacked the local hill rulers and asked them to join the attack against GURU SAHIB. Some rulers approached GURU SAHIB. Here a big battle was fought and Dilawar Khans son was killed and Mughal army ran away. Bhai Sangatia, Bhai Darso and Bhai Jujhar Singh Rajput also succumbed to their injuries. GURU SAHIB himself took care of them.</p>

In those times, the Ravi River flowed right next to the fort's wall. Before this, Guru Sahib was tortured at the place where Gurdwara Shri Lal Khoohi Sahib is situated. Guru Sahib was made to sit on a hot plate, and hot sand was poured over him. On the fifth day, Guru Sahib requested permission to bathe, and at this place, he submerged into the Ravi River and never returned.

A platform was raised at that place which is on ground floor of building.

GURDWARA SHRI KANGAN GHAT SAHIB situated in the Distt City Patna.

It is situated on walking distance from GURDWARA TAKHAT SHRI HARIMANDIR JI PATNA SAHIB. SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI (GOBIND RAI JI) used to play here with his Mates during his childhood.(In those times river Ganges used to flow here). Once GURU SAHIB had thrown the golden bracelet in Ganges, as he was not fond of Temporal Wealth. Another Important event is meeting of GOBIND RAI with Priest Shiv Dutt, who was worshipper of Rama. He used to worship Rama through Idol of King Rama and perform daily rituals like Keeping food before idol and wait for Rama to come. GURU SAHIB guided him that Rama could not be attained through Idols, as it is present in all aliveness. Adi SRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI states "Sabey Ghat Ram bole Ram Boley, Ram Bina ko boley re". Rama could be attained within himself. The guidance of true Rama opened eyes of Shivdutt and he left idol worship.

data.description:
GURDWARA SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI SAHIB is situated in the Mandi Town.

This Gurdwara Sahib was also Known as Gurdwara Sri Padal Sahib. It is situated on the National Highway no 21 on Mandi-Kullu. SHRI GURU GOBIND SINGH JI came to this place on invitation from Mandi ruler Raja Sidh Sen. GURU SAHIB stayed pitched his tent here and Mata ji's were accommodated in the Rulers Palace. The Inner place is maintained by the Rulers family. GURU SAHIB stayed here for 6 Months 19 days. When GURU SAHIB was about to leave Mandi, One day Raja Sidh Sen requested GURU SAHIB that he's leaving Mandi. Who will save us from Aurangzebs Cruelty. At that moment GURU SAHIB was aiming on Clay Pitcher in River Beas. GURU SAHIB fired on pitcher and it got an whole and was saved and still floating in River. GURU SAHIB said

"JAISE BACHI YE HANDI VAISE BACHEGI TERI MANDI

JO MANDI KO LUTENGE AASMANI GOLE CHUTENGE "

There are GURU SAHIBS belongings which are still preserved here.

1). Holy Bed.

2). Holy Rawab.

3). Holy Gun.

4). Holy Gun Kuppy.

5). Holy Talai (Matterss).

Theres also an rock in River Beas on which GURU SAHIB used to meditate daily during his stay in Mandi.
